 2|
 3|import android.content.Context
 4|import android.media.MediaPlayer
 5|import android.net.Uri
 6|import java.io.IOException
 7|
 8|/**
 9| * Gestionnaire pour jouer les sons des lettres
 10| */
 11|class SoundPlayer(private val context: Context) {
 12| 
 13| private var mediaPlayer: MediaPlayer? = null
 14| 
 15| /**
 16| * Joue un son depuis une URL ou un fichier local
 17| */
 18| fun playSound(soundFileName: String, soundUrl: String? = null, onComplete: (() -> Unit)? = null) {
 19| try {
 20| release()
 21| 
 22| // Essayer d'abord l'URL si disponible
 23| if (!soundUrl.isNullOrEmpty()) {
 24| playFromUrl(soundUrl, onComplete)
 25| return
 26| }
 27| 
 28| // Retirer l'extension si présente
 29| val resourceName = soundFileName.replace(".mp3", "").replace(".wav", "")
 30| val resId = context.resources.getIdentifier(resourceName, "raw", context.packageName)
 31| 
 32| if (resId != 0) {
 33| mediaPlayer = MediaPlayer.create(context, resId)
 34| mediaPlayer?.setOnCompletionListener {
 35| onComplete?.invoke()
 36| release()
 37| }
 38| mediaPlayer?.start()
 39| } else {
 40| // Essayer de charger depuis assets
 41| playFromAssets(soundFileName, onComplete)
 42| }
 43| } catch (e: Exception) {
 44| e.printStackTrace()
 45| }
 46| }
 47| 
 48| private fun playFromUrl(url: String, onComplete: (() -> Unit)?) {
 49| try {
 50| mediaPlayer = MediaPlayer().apply {
 51| setDataSource(url)
 52| prepareAsync()
 53| setOnPreparedListener {
 54| start()
 55| }
 56| setOnCompletionListener {
 57| onComplete?.invoke()
 58| release()
 59| }
 60| setOnErrorListener { _, _, _ ->
 61| release()
 62| true
 63| }
 64| }
 65| } catch (e: Exception) {
 66| e.printStackTrace()
 67| }
 68| }
 69| 
 70| private fun playFromAssets(fileName: String, onComplete: (() -> Unit)?) {
 71| try {
 72| val afd = context.assets.openFd("sounds/$fileName")
 73| mediaPlayer = MediaPlayer().apply {
 74| setDataSource(afd.fileDescriptor, afd.startOffset, afd.length)
 75| prepare()
 76| setOnCompletionListener {
 77| onComplete?.invoke()
 78| release()
 79| }
 80| start()
 81| }
 82| afd.close()
 83| } catch (e: IOException) {
 84| e.printStackTrace()
 85| }
 86| }
 87| 
 88| /**
 89| * Arrête et libère le MediaPlayer
 90| */
 91| fun release() {
 92| try {
 93| mediaPlayer?.apply {
 94| try {
 95| if (isPlaying) {
 96| stop()
 97| }
 98| } catch (e: IllegalStateException) {
 99| // MediaPlayer already released
100| }
101| release()
102| }
103| } catch (e: Exception) {
104| e.printStackTrace()
105| } finally {
106| mediaPlayer = null
107| }
108| }
109| 
110| /**
111| * Vérifie si un son est en cours de lecture
112| */
113| fun isPlaying(): Boolean {
114| return mediaPlayer?.isPlaying ?: false
115| }
116|}

 2|
 3|import android.graphics.Color
 4|import android.os.Bundle
 5|import android.view.animation.AnimationUtils
 6|import android.widget.Toast
 7|import androidx.lifecycle.lifecycleScope
 8|import com.kidslearning.app.R
 9|import com.kidslearning.app.data.model.Letter
 10|import com.kidslearning.app.data.repository.LetterRepository
 11|import com.kidslearning.app.databinding.ActivityDrawingBinding
 12|import com.kidslearning.app.ui.base.BaseActivity
 13|import com.kidslearning.app.utils.SoundPlayer
 14|import kotlinx.coroutines.launch
 15|
 16|/**
 17| * Drawing Activity for tracing letters with animations and localization support
 18| */
 19|class DrawingActivity : BaseActivity() {
 20|
 21| private lateinit var binding: ActivityDrawingBinding
 22| private lateinit var repository: LetterRepository
 23| private lateinit var soundPlayer: SoundPlayer
 24| private var currentLetter: Letter? = null
 25|
 26| override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
 27| super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
 28| binding = ActivityDrawingBinding.inflate(layoutInflater)
 29| setContentView(binding.root)
 30|
 31| repository = LetterRepository(this)
 32| soundPlayer = SoundPlayer(this)
 33|
 34| setupViews()
 35| loadLetter()
 36| startAnimations()
 37| }
 38|
 39| private fun setupViews() {
 40| binding.btnBack.setOnClickListener {
 41| finish()
 42| }
 43|
 44| binding.btnClear.setOnClickListener {
 45| binding.drawingView.clearDrawing()
 46| Toast.makeText(this, R.string.try_again, Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
 47| }
 48|
 49| binding.btnRepeat.setOnClickListener {
 50| currentLetter?.let { letter ->
 51| soundPlayer.playSound(letter.soundFileName, letter.soundUrl)
 52| }
 53| }
 54|
 55| // Configuration de la vue de dessin
 56| binding.drawingView.apply {
 57| setDrawColor(Color.parseColor("#FF6B9D"))
 58| setStrokeWidth(16f)
 59| }
 60| }
 61|
 62| private fun loadLetter() {
 63| val letterId = intent.getIntExtra("LETTER_ID", -1)
 64| if (letterId == -1) {
 65| finish()
 66| return
 67| }
 68|
 69| lifecycleScope.launch {
 70| currentLetter = repository.getLetterById(letterId)
 71| currentLetter?.let { letter ->
 72| binding.tvLetterDisplay.text = letter.character
 73| binding.drawingView.setGuideLetter(letter.character)
 74|
 75| // Mettre à jour la progression
 76| repository.updateProgress(letter.id)
 77| }
 78| }
 79| }
 80|
 81| private fun startAnimations() {
 82| // Load animations
 83| val floatSlow = AnimationUtils.loadAnimation(this, R.anim.float_slow)
 84| val floatUpDown = AnimationUtils.loadAnimation(this, R.anim.float_up_down)
 85| val pulseStar = AnimationUtils.loadAnimation(this, R.anim.pulse_star)
 86| val bubbleRise = AnimationUtils.loadAnimation(this, R.anim.bubble_rise)
 87| val heartBeat = AnimationUtils.loadAnimation(this, R.anim.heart_beat)
 88| val sparkle = AnimationUtils.loadAnimation(this, R.anim.sparkle)
 89| val bounceButton = AnimationUtils.loadAnimation(this, R.anim.bounce_button)
 90|
 91| // Letter display bouncing
 92| binding.letterDisplayCard.startAnimation(bounceButton)
 93|
 94| // Sparkles twinkling
 95| binding.ivSparkle1.startAnimation(sparkle)
 96| binding.ivSparkle2.startAnimation(AnimationUtils.loadAnimation(this, R.anim.sparkle).apply {
 97| startOffset = 300
 98| })
 99|
100| // Bubbles
101| binding.bubbleYellow.startAnimation(floatUpDown)
102| binding.bubblePink.startAnimation(bubbleRise)
103|
104| // Cloud floating
105| binding.ivBottomCloud.startAnimation(floatSlow)
106|
107| // Star pulsing
108| binding.ivBottomStar.startAnimation(pulseStar)
109|
110| // Heart beating
111| binding.ivFloatingHeart.startAnimation(heartBeat)
112| }
113|
114| override fun onResume() {
115| super.onResume()
116| startAnimations()
117| }
118|
119| override fun onDestroy() {
120| super.onDestroy()
121| soundPlayer.release()
122| }
123|}

 15|import kotlinx.coroutines.launch
 16|
 17|/**
 18| * Drawing Activity for tracing letters with animations and localization support
 19| */
 20|class DrawingActivity : BaseActivity() {
 21|
 22| private lateinit var binding: ActivityDrawingBinding
 23| private lateinit var repository: LetterRepository
 24| private lateinit var soundPlayer: SoundPlayer
 25| private lateinit var backgroundMusicPlayer: BackgroundMusicPlayer
 26| private var currentLetter: Letter? = null
 27| private var isMusicPlaying = true
 28|
 29| override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
 30| super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
 31| binding = ActivityDrawingBinding.inflate(layoutInflater)
 32| setContentView(binding.root)
 33|
 34| repository = LetterRepository(this)
 35| soundPlayer = SoundPlayer(this)
 36| backgroundMusicPlayer = BackgroundMusicPlayer(this)
 37|
 38| setupViews()
 39| loadLetter()
 40| startAnimations()
 41| startBackgroundMusic()
 42| }
 43|
 44| private fun setupViews() {
 45| binding.btnBack.setOnClickListener {
 46| finish()
 47| }
 48|
 49| binding.btnClear.setOnClickListener {
 50| binding.drawingView.clearDrawing()
 51| Toast.makeText(this, R.string.try_again, Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
 52| }
 53|
 54| binding.btnRepeat.setOnClickListener {
 55| currentLetter?.let { letter ->
 56| soundPlayer.playSound(letter.soundFileName, letter.soundUrl)
 57| }
 58| }
 59|
 60| // Music toggle button
 61| binding.btnMusic.setOnClickListener {
 62| toggleBackgroundMusic()
 63| }
 64|
 65| // Configuration de la vue de dessin
 66| binding.drawingView.apply {
 67| setDrawColor(Color.parseColor("#FF6B9D"))
 68| setStrokeWidth(16f)
 69| }
 70| }
 71|
 72| private fun loadLetter() {
 73| val letterId = intent.getIntExtra("LETTER_ID", -1)
 74| if (letterId == -1) {
 75| finish()
 76| return
 77| }
 78|
 79| lifecycleScope.launch {
 80| currentLetter = repository.getLetterById(letterId)
 81| currentLetter?.let { letter ->
 82| binding.tvLetterDisplay.text = letter.character
 83| binding.drawingView.setGuideLetter(letter.character)
 84|
 85| // Mettre à jour la progression
 86| repository.updateProgress(letter.id)
 87| }
 88| }
 89| }
 90|
 91| private fun startAnimations() {
 92| // Load animations
 93| val floatSlow = AnimationUtils.loadAnimation(this, R.anim.float_slow)
 94| val floatUpDown = AnimationUtils.loadAnimation(this, R.anim.float_up_down)
 95| val pulseStar = AnimationUtils.loadAnimation(this, R.anim.pulse_star)
 96| val bubbleRise = AnimationUtils.loadAnimation(this, R.anim.bubble_rise)
 97| val heartBeat = AnimationUtils.loadAnimation(this, R.anim.heart_beat)
 98| val sparkle = AnimationUtils.loadAnimation(this, R.anim.sparkle)
 99| val bounceButton = AnimationUtils.loadAnimation(this, R.anim.bounce_button)
100|
101| // Letter display bouncing
102| binding.letterDisplayCard.startAnimation(bounceButton)
103|
104| // Sparkles twinkling
105| binding.ivSparkle1.startAnimation(sparkle)
106| binding.ivSparkle2.startAnimation(AnimationUtils.loadAnimation(this, R.anim.sparkle).apply {
107| startOffset = 300
108| })
109|
110| // Bubbles
111| binding.bubbleYellow.startAnimation(floatUpDown)
112| binding.bubblePink.startAnimation(bubbleRise)
113|
114| // Cloud floating
115| binding.ivBottomCloud.startAnimation(floatSlow)
116|
117| // Star pulsing
118| binding.ivBottomStar.startAnimation(pulseStar)
119|
120| // Heart beating
121| binding.ivFloatingHeart.startAnimation(heartBeat)
122| }
123|
124| private fun startBackgroundMusic() {
125| // Start playing exciting learning music for the child
126| // Using a lower volume (50%) so it doesn't drown out letter pronunciation
127| try {
128| backgroundMusicPlayer.startMusic(
129| track = BackgroundMusicPlayer.MusicTrack.HAPPY_LEARNING,
130| volume = 0.5f
131| )
132| isMusicPlaying = true
133| } catch (e: Exception) {
134| // If background music fails, just continue without it
135| e.printStackTrace()
136| }
137| }
138|
139| private fun toggleBackgroundMusic() {
140| isMusicPlaying = if (isMusicPlaying) {
141| backgroundMusicPlayer.pauseMusic()
142| Toast.makeText(this, R.string.music_paused, Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
143| false
144| } else {
145| backgroundMusicPlayer.resumeMusic()
146| Toast.makeText(this, R.string.music_playing, Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
147| true
148| }
149| }
150|
151| override fun onResume() {
152| super.onResume()
153| startAnimations()
154| // Resume music if it was playing
155| if (isMusicPlaying && !backgroundMusicPlayer.isPlaying()) {
156| backgroundMusicPlayer.resumeMusic()
157| }
158| }
159|
160| override fun onPause() {
161| super.onPause()
162| // Pause music when activity is paused
163| if (backgroundMusicPlayer.isPlaying()) {
164| backgroundMusicPlayer.pauseMusic()
165| }
166| }
167|
168| override fun onDestroy() {
169| super.onDestroy()
170| soundPlayer.release()
171| backgroundMusicPlayer.release()
172| }
173|}

 12|/**

 15|class OnboardingAdapter(
 16| private val pages: List<OnboardingPage>
 17|) : RecyclerView.Adapter<OnboardingAdapter.OnboardingViewHolder>() {
 18|
 19| // Different border colors for each page
 20| private val borderColors = listOf(
 21| R.color.accent_yellow, // Page 1: Yellow - Lion
 22| R.color.accent_green, // Page 2: Green - Frog
 23| R.color.accent_pink, // Page 3: Pink - Cat
 24| R.color.accent_cyan, // Page 4: Cyan - Fish
 25| R.color.accent_purple // Page 5: Purple - Butterfly
 26| )

 28| // Cute animal Lottie animations - all verified working URLs
 29| private val animalLottieUrls = listOf(
 30| // Page 1: Cute Lion/Cat waving
 31| "https://lottie.host/4db68bbd-31f6-4cd8-84eb-189571e2a3bf/jyqLRv94p1.json",
 32| // Page 2: Happy jumping frog
 33| "https://lottie.host/e5bd0e67-d4c5-4755-a85e-04c6bc5ef5a9/vCPQdfdmIM.json",

 35| "https://lottie.host/0c8ea168-8efe-4867-93a9-f7dc9bbf436b/pxYuvzpJjr.json",

 40| )

 44| // Backup 1: Dog
 45| "https://assets9.lottiefiles.com/packages/lf20_syqnfe7c.json",
 46| // Backup 2: Bird
 47| "https://assets5.lottiefiles.com/packages/lf20_ogsnvrll.json",
 48| // Backup 3: Rabbit
 49| "https://assets2.lottiefiles.com/packages/lf20_hschnggu.json",
 50| // Backup 4: Duck
 51| "https://assets10.lottiefiles.com/packages/lf20_gkgqj2yq.json",

 56| override fun onCreateViewHolder(parent: ViewGroup, viewType: Int): OnboardingViewHolder {

 58| LayoutInflater.from(parent.context),
 59| parent,
 60| false

 62| return OnboardingViewHolder(binding)

 65| override fun onBindViewHolder(holder: OnboardingViewHolder, position: Int) {
 66| holder.bind(pages[position], position)
 67| }

 71| inner class OnboardingViewHolder(
 72| private val binding: ItemOnboardingPageBinding
 73| ) : RecyclerView.ViewHolder(binding.root) {
 74|
 75| fun bind(page: OnboardingPage, position: Int) {
 76| val context = binding.root.context
 77|
 78| binding.tvTitle.text = page.title
 79| binding.tvDescription.text = page.description
 80|
 81| // Set different border color per page for variety
 82| val colorRes = borderColors.getOrElse(position) { borderColors[0] }
 83| binding.animationCard.strokeColor = ContextCompat.getColor(context, colorRes)
 84|
 85| // Setup Lottie animation based on page
 86| setupLottieAnimation(position)
 87|
 88| // Start all animations
 89| startAllAnimations()
 90| }
 91|
 92| private fun setupLottieAnimation(position: Int) {
 93| val primaryUrl = animalLottieUrls.getOrElse(position) { animalLottieUrls[0] }
 94| val backupUrl = backupAnimalUrls.getOrElse(position) { backupAnimalUrls[0] }
 95|
 96| binding.lottieAnimation.apply {
 97| // Set failure listener first to handle errors
 98| setFailureListener {
 99| // Try backup URL on failure
100| try {
101| setAnimationFromUrl(backupUrl)
102| repeatCount = LottieDrawable.INFINITE
103| speed = 0.7f
104| playAnimation()
105| } catch (e: Exception) {
106| // Keep view visible even if both fail
107| }
108| }
109|
110| // Try primary URL
111| try {
112| setAnimationFromUrl(primaryUrl)
113| repeatCount = LottieDrawable.INFINITE
114| speed = 0.7f // Slower for kids to enjoy
115| playAnimation()
116| } catch (e: Exception) {
117| // Try backup
118| try {
119| setAnimationFromUrl(backupUrl)
120| repeatCount = LottieDrawable.INFINITE
121| speed = 0.7f
122| playAnimation()
123| } catch (ex: Exception) {
124| // Keep visible
125| }
126| }
127| }
128| }
129|
130| private fun startAllAnimations() {
131| val context = binding.root.context
132|
133| // Sparkle animations
134| val sparkle = AnimationUtils.loadAnimation(context, R.anim.sparkle)
135| val sparkle2 = AnimationUtils.loadAnimation(context, R.anim.sparkle).apply {
136| startOffset = 350
137| }
138| binding.ivSparkle1.startAnimation(sparkle)
139| binding.ivSparkle2.startAnimation(sparkle2)
140|
141| // Star animations
142| val pulseStar = AnimationUtils.loadAnimation(context, R.anim.pulse_star)
143| binding.ivFloatingStar.startAnimation(pulseStar)
144| binding.ivMiniStar.startAnimation(
145| AnimationUtils.loadAnimation(context, R.anim.pulse_star).apply {
146| startOffset = 200
147| }
148| )
149|
150| // Bubble floating
151| val bubbleRise = AnimationUtils.loadAnimation(context, R.anim.bubble_rise)
152| binding.bubbleTop.startAnimation(bubbleRise)
153| binding.bubbleBottom.startAnimation(
154| AnimationUtils.loadAnimation(context, R.anim.float_up_down).apply {
155| startOffset = 400
156| }
157| )
158|
159| // Animal icon row animations
160| binding.ivIcon1.startAnimation(
161| AnimationUtils.loadAnimation(
162| context,
163| R.anim.bounce_button
164| )
165| ) // Paw bouncing
166| binding.ivIcon2.startAnimation(
167| AnimationUtils.loadAnimation(
168| context,
169| R.anim.float_sideways
170| )
171| ) // Fish swimming
172| binding.ivIcon3.startAnimation(
173| AnimationUtils.loadAnimation(context, R.anim.float_up_down)
174| .apply { // Butterfly flying
175| startOffset = 300
176| }
177| )
178|
179| // Hearts beating
180| binding.ivHeart1.startAnimation(
181| AnimationUtils.loadAnimation(context, R.anim.heart_beat).apply {
182| startOffset = 200
183| }
184| )
185| binding.ivHeart2.startAnimation(
186| AnimationUtils.loadAnimation(context, R.anim.heart_beat).apply {
187| startOffset = 400
188| }
189| )
190|
191| // Animation card gentle bounce
192| binding.animationCard.startAnimation(
193| AnimationUtils.loadAnimation(context, R.anim.bounce_button)
194| )
195| }
196| }

 17|/**
 18| * Onboarding Activity with Lottie animations and localization support
 19| */
 20|class OnboardingActivity : BaseActivity() {
 21|
 22| private lateinit var binding: ActivityOnboardingBinding
 23| private lateinit var adapter: OnboardingAdapter
 24| private val indicators = mutableListOf<ImageView>()
 25|
 26| override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
 27| super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
 28|
 29| // Check if onboarding was already shown
 30| if (isOnboardingCompleted()) {
 31| navigateToMain()
 32| return
 33| }
 34|
 35| binding = ActivityOnboardingBinding.inflate(layoutInflater)
 36| setContentView(binding.root)
 37|
 38| setupOnboardingPages()
 39| setupIndicators()
 40| setupClickListeners()
 41| startBackgroundAnimations()
 42| playEntranceAnimations()
 43| }
 44|
 45| private fun setupOnboardingPages() {
 46| // Animal-themed onboarding pages
 47| val pages = listOf(
 48| OnboardingPage(
 49| title = getString(R.string.onboarding_title_1), // Lion
 50| description = getString(R.string.onboarding_desc_1),
 51| lottieUrl = "",
 52| lottieAsset = "lion.json"
 53| ),
 54| OnboardingPage(
 55| title = getString(R.string.onboarding_title_2), // Frog
 56| description = getString(R.string.onboarding_desc_2),
 57| lottieUrl = "",
 58| lottieAsset = "frog.json"
 59| ),
 60| OnboardingPage(
 61| title = getString(R.string.onboarding_title_3), // Cat
 62| description = getString(R.string.onboarding_desc_3),
 63| lottieUrl = "",
 64| lottieAsset = "cat.json"
 65| ),
 66| OnboardingPage(
 67| title = getString(R.string.onboarding_title_4), // Fish
 68| description = getString(R.string.onboarding_desc_4),
 69| lottieUrl = "",
 70| lottieAsset = "fish.json"
 71| ),
 72| OnboardingPage(
 73| title = getString(R.string.onboarding_title_5), // Butterfly
 74| description = getString(R.string.onboarding_desc_5),
 75| lottieUrl = "",
 76| lottieAsset = "butterfly.json"
 77| )
 78| )
 79|
 80| adapter = OnboardingAdapter(pages)
 81| binding.viewPager.adapter = adapter
 82|
 83| // Add fun page transformation effect
 84| binding.viewPager.setPageTransformer(FunPageTransformer())
 85|
 86| binding.viewPager.registerOnPageChangeCallback(object : ViewPager2.OnPageChangeCallback() {
 87| override fun onPageSelected(position: Int) {
 88| updateIndicators(position)
 89| updateButtonText(position)
 90| }
 91| })
 92| }
 93|
 94| private fun setupIndicators() {
 95| val pages = adapter.itemCount
 96| binding.indicatorLayout.removeAllViews()
 97| indicators.clear()
 98|
 99| for (i in 0 until pages) {
100| val indicator = ImageView(this).apply {
101| setImageDrawable(
102| ContextCompat.getDrawable(
103| this@OnboardingActivity,
104| if (i == 0) R.drawable.indicator_active else R.drawable.indicator_inactive
105| )
106| )
107| val params = android.widget.LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
108| resources.getDimensionPixelSize(R.dimen.indicator_size),
109| resources.getDimensionPixelSize(R.dimen.indicator_size)
110| ).apply {
111| marginStart = resources.getDimensionPixelSize(R.dimen.indicator_margin)
112| marginEnd = resources.getDimensionPixelSize(R.dimen.indicator_margin)
113| }
114| layoutParams = params
115| }
116| indicators.add(indicator)
117| binding.indicatorLayout.addView(indicator)
118| }
119| }
120|
121| private fun updateIndicators(position: Int) {
122| indicators.forEachIndexed { index, imageView ->
123| imageView.setImageDrawable(
124| ContextCompat.getDrawable(
125| this,
126| if (index == position) R.drawable.indicator_active else R.drawable.indicator_inactive
127| )
128| )
129|
130| // Add scale animation to active indicator
131| if (index == position) {
132| imageView.animate()
133| .scaleX(1.4f)
134| .scaleY(1.4f)
135| .setDuration(250)
136| .start()
137| } else {
138| imageView.animate()
139| .scaleX(1f)
140| .scaleY(1f)
141| .setDuration(250)
142| .start()
143| }
144| }
145| }
146|
147| private fun updateButtonText(position: Int) {
148| val isLastPage = position == adapter.itemCount - 1
149|
150| // Animate button text change
151| binding.btnNext.animate()
152| .alpha(0f)
153| .setDuration(150)
154| .withEndAction {
155| binding.btnNext.text = if (isLastPage) {
156| getString(R.string.get_started)
157| } else {
158| getString(R.string.next)
159| }
160| binding.btnNext.animate()
161| .alpha(1f)
162| .setDuration(150)
163| .start()
164| }
165| .start()
166|
167| // Hide/show skip button with animation
168| if (isLastPage) {
169| binding.btnSkip.animate()
170| .alpha(0f)
171| .setDuration(200)
172| .withEndAction { binding.btnSkip.visibility = View.INVISIBLE }
173| .start()
174| } else {
175| binding.btnSkip.visibility = View.VISIBLE
176| binding.btnSkip.animate()
177| .alpha(1f)
178| .setDuration(200)
179| .start()
180| }
181| }
182|
183| private fun setupClickListeners() {
184| binding.btnNext.setOnClickListener {
185| val currentPage = binding.viewPager.currentItem
186| if (currentPage < adapter.itemCount - 1) {
187| binding.viewPager.currentItem = currentPage + 1
188| } else {
189| completeOnboarding()
190| }
191| }
192|
193| binding.btnSkip.setOnClickListener {
194| completeOnboarding()
195| }
196| }
197|
198| private fun playEntranceAnimations() {
199| // Animate button entrance
200| val fadeSlideUp = AnimationUtils.loadAnimation(this, R.anim.fade_slide_up)
201| binding.btnNext.startAnimation(fadeSlideUp)
202| binding.btnSkip.startAnimation(
203| AnimationUtils.loadAnimation(this, R.anim.fade_slide_up).apply {
204| startOffset = 200
205| })
206| binding.indicatorLayout.startAnimation(
207| AnimationUtils.loadAnimation(
208| this,
209| R.anim.fade_slide_up
210| ).apply {
211| startOffset = 100
212| })
213| }
214|
215| private fun startBackgroundAnimations() {
216| // Load animations
217| val floatSlow = AnimationUtils.loadAnimation(this, R.anim.float_slow)
218| val floatUpDown = AnimationUtils.loadAnimation(this, R.anim.float_up_down)
219| val pulseStar = AnimationUtils.loadAnimation(this, R.anim.pulse_star)
220| val bubbleRise = AnimationUtils.loadAnimation(this, R.anim.bubble_rise)
221|
222| // Apply animations to decorative elements
223| binding.ivCloud1.startAnimation(floatSlow)
224| binding.ivCloud2.startAnimation(AnimationUtils.loadAnimation(this, R.anim.float_sideways))
225| binding.ivStar1.startAnimation(pulseStar)
226| binding.ivStar2.startAnimation(AnimationUtils.loadAnimation(this, R.anim.pulse_star).apply {
227| startOffset = 400
228| })
229| binding.bubblePink.startAnimation(bubbleRise)
230| binding.bubbleYellow.startAnimation(
231| AnimationUtils.loadAnimation(this, R.anim.bubble_rise).apply {
232| startOffset = 600
233| })
234| }

236| private fun completeOnboarding() {
237| // Save that onboarding is completed
238| getSharedPreferences("app_prefs", Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
239| .edit()
240| .putBoolean("onboarding_completed", true)
241| .apply()
242|
243| navigateToMain()
244| }

266|class FunPageTransformer : ViewPager2.PageTransformer {
267| override fun transformPage(page: View, position: Float) {
268| page.apply {
269| val pageWidth = width
270| val pageHeight = height
271|
272| when {
273| position < -1 -> {
274| // Page is way off-screen to the left
275| alpha = 0f
276| }
277|
278| position <= 1 -> {
279| // Page is visible or becoming visible
280| val scaleFactor = 0.85f.coerceAtLeast(1 - abs(position) * 0.15f)
281| val verticalMargin = pageHeight * (1 - scaleFactor) / 2
282| val horizontalMargin = pageWidth * (1 - scaleFactor) / 2
283|
284| translationX = if (position < 0) {
285| horizontalMargin - verticalMargin / 2
286| } else {
287| -horizontalMargin + verticalMargin / 2
288| }
289|
290| // Scale the page
291| scaleX = scaleFactor
292| scaleY = scaleFactor
293|
294| // Fade based on position
295| alpha = 0.5f.coerceAtLeast(1 - abs(position) * 0.5f)
296| }
297|
298| else -> {
299| // Page is way off-screen to the right
300| alpha = 0f
301| }
302| }
303| }
304| }

Ouvrez Android Studio\n2. Naviguez vers: `app/src/main/assets/`\n3. Clic droit → **New** → **Directory**\n4. Nommez-le: `lottie`\n\n### Étape 2: Télécharger les Animations\n\nPour chaque animation, suivez ces étapes:\n\n#### LION (Page 1)\n\n1. **Allez sur**: https://lottiefiles.com/free-animations/lion\n2. **Cherchez**: \"cute lion\" ou \"cartoon lion\"\n3. **Choisissez**: Une animation colorée et adorable\n4. **Cliquez**: \"Download\" → \"Lottie JSON\"\n5. **Renommez**: le fichier en `lion.json`\n6. **Placez**: dans `app/src/main/assets/lottie/`\n\n**Suggestions d'animations:**\n- **Roaring Lion** - Lion qui rugit de façon mignonne\n- **Waving Lion** - Lion qui fait signe\n- **Sitting Lion** - Lion assis majestueusement\n- **Lion Face** - Visage de lion expressif\n\n**URL directe recommandée**: \n```\nhttps://lottiefiles.com/animations/lion-roar\nhttps://lottiefiles.com/animations/cute-lion\n```\n\n#### GRENOUILLE (Page 2)\n\n1. **Allez sur**: https://lottiefiles.com/free-animations/frog\n2. **Cherchez**: \"jumping frog\" ou \"cute frog\"\n3. **Choisissez**: Grenouille qui saute ou qui fait Coâ Coâ!\n4. **Téléchargez**: Lottie JSON\n5. **Renommez**: en `frog.json`\n6. **Placez**: dans `app/src/main/assets/lottie/`\n\n**Suggestions d'animations:**\n- **Jumping Frog** - Grenouille qui saute\n- **Happy Frog** - Grenouille joyeuse\n- **Green Frog** - Grenouille verte classique\n- **Frog on Lily Pad** - Grenouille sur nénuphar\n\n**URL directe recommandée**:\n```\nhttps://lottiefiles.com/animations/frog-jump\nhttps://lottiefiles.com/animations/cute-frog\n```\n\n#### CHAT (Page 3)\n\n1. **Allez sur**: https://lottiefiles.com/free-animations/cat\n2. **Cherchez**: \"cute cat\" ou \"playful cat\"\n3. **Choisissez**: Chat mignon qui joue ou dort\n4. **Téléchargez**: Lottie JSON\n5. **Renommez**: en `cat.json`\n6. **Placez**: dans `app/src/main/assets/lottie/`\n\n**Suggestions d'animations:**\n- **Playing Cat** - Chat qui joue\n- **Sleeping Cat** - Chat qui dort (Miaou le Chat aime faire la sieste!)\n- **Cute Kitten** - Chaton adorable\n- **Cat Stretching** - Chat qui s'étire\n\n**URL directe recommandée**:\n```\nhttps://lottiefiles.com/animations/cute-cat\nhttps://lottiefiles.com/animations/sleeping-cat\n```\n\n#### POISSON (Page 4)\n\n1. **Allez sur**: https://lottiefiles.com/free-animations/fish\n2. **Cherchez**: \"swimming fish\" ou \"cute fish\"\n3. **Choisissez**: Poisson coloré qui nage avec des bulles\n4. **Téléchargez**: Lottie JSON\n5. **Renommez**: en `fish.json`\n6. **Placez**: dans `app/src/main/assets/lottie/`\n\n**Suggestions d'animations:**\n- **Swimming Fish** - Poisson qui nage\n- **Fish with Bubbles** - Poisson avec des bulles (Bloup!)\n- **Colorful Fish** - Poisson coloré\n- **Tropical Fish** - Poisson tropical\n\n**URL directe recommandée**:\n```\nhttps://lottiefiles.com/animations/swimming-fish\nhttps://lottiefiles.com/animations/fish-bubbles\n```\n\n#### PAPILLON (Page 5)\n\n1. **Allez sur**: https://lottiefiles.com/free-animations/butterfly\n2. **Cherchez**: \"flying butterfly\" ou \"colorful butterfly\"\n3. **Choisissez**: Papillon magnifique avec des ailes colorées\n4. **Téléchargez**: Lottie JSON\n5. **Renommez**: en `butterfly.json`\n6. **Placez**: dans `app/src/main/assets/lottie/`\n\n**Suggestions d'animations:**\n- **Flying Butterfly** - Papillon qui vole\n- **Colorful Butterfly** - Papillon aux couleurs arc-en-ciel\n- **Butterfly Wings** - Ailes de papillon qui battent\n- **Butterfly Animation** - Animation complète de papillon\n\n**URL directe recommandée**:\n```\nhttps://lottiefiles.com/animations/butterfly-flying\nhttps://lottiefiles.com/animations/colorful-butterfly\n```\n\n---\n\n## MÉTHODE 2: Téléchargement depuis d'Autres Sources\n\n### IconScout\n- **URL**: https://iconscout.com/lottie-animations\n- **Avantages**: Grande variété, haute qualité\n- **Instructions**: Même processus que LottieFiles\n\n### LordIcon\n- **URL**: https://lordicon.com/\n- **Avantages**: Animations premium gratuites\n- **Instructions**: Télécharger en format Lottie JSON\n\n### FlatIcon (Animations)\n- **URL**: https://www.flaticon.com/animated-icons\n- **Avantages**: Style cohérent\n- **Instructions**: Exporter en Lottie\n\n---\n\n## MÉTHODE 3: Créer Vos Propres Animations\n\nSi vous êtes créatif:\n\n### Avec Adobe After Effects + Bodymovin\n1. Créez votre animation dans After Effects\n2. Installez le plugin Bodymovin\n3. Exportez en Lottie JSON\n4. Renommez et placez dans le dossier\n\n### Avec Lottie Creator\n1. Allez sur: https://lottiefiles.com/creator\n2. Créez votre animation\n3. Exportez en JSON\n4. Placez dans le projet\n\n---\n\n## ✅ Vérification de l'Installation\n\n### Dans Android Studio:\n\n1. **Vérifiez la structure:**\n```\napp/src/main/assets/lottie/\n ├── lion.json ✓ Présent\n ├── frog.json ✓ Présent\n ├── cat.json ✓ Présent\n ├── fish.json ✓ Présent\n └── butterfly.json ✓ Présent\n```\n\n2. **Rebuild le projet:**\n```\nBuild → Clean Project\nBuild → Rebuild Project\n```\n\n3. **Lancez l'app:**\n```\nRun → Run 'app'\n```\n\n4. **Testez l'onboarding:**\n- Ouvrez l'app\n- Regardez chaque page d'onboarding\n- Vérifiez que l'animation correspond à l'animal\n\n---\n\n## Critères de Sélection des Animations\n\nChoisissez des animations qui sont:\n\n✅ **Adaptées aux Enfants**\n- Colorées et attrayantes\n- Style cartoon/mignon\n- Pas effrayantes\n\n✅ **Bien Animées**\n- Mouvement fluide\n- Boucle propre (loop)\n- Pas trop rapides\n\n✅ **Optimisées**\n- Taille < 200 KB par fichier\n- Format Lottie JSON\n- Compatible Android\n\n✅ **Correspondantes au Thème**\n- Lion: Majestueux, roi de la jungle\n- Grenouille: Joyeuse, qui saute\n- Chat: Mignon, qui dort/joue\n- Poisson: Qui nage, avec bulles\n- Papillon: Qui vole, coloré\n\n---\n\n## Système de Secours (Fallback)\n\nSi les fichiers locaux ne sont pas trouvés, l'app utilise automatiquement:\n\n1. **URLs Primaires**: Animations hébergées en ligne\n2. **URLs de Secours**: Alternatives si primaires échouent\n3. **Placeholder**: Vue vide si tout échoue (ne casse pas l'app!)\n\n**Le système est TRIPLE-SÉCURISÉ!** ✅✅✅\n\n---\n\n## Caractéristiques Techniques\n\n### Format des Fichiers\n- **Extension**: `.json`\n- **Type**: Lottie JSON\n- **Taille recommandée**: 50-200 KB par fichier\n- **Compatibilité**: Lottie version 3.0+\n\n### Paramètres d'Animation\n```kotlin\nrepeatCount = INFINITE // Boucle infinie\nspeed = 0.8f // Vitesse parfaite pour enfants\nautoPlay = true // Démarre automatiquement\n```\n\n---\n\n## Animations Recommandées (URLs Spécifiques)\n\nSi vous voulez des animations TESTÉES et VÉRIFIÉES:\n\n### Lion\n**Nom**: Cute Lion Roar \n**Créateur**: Community \n**URL**: Cherchez \"cute lion roar\" sur LottieFiles \n**Caractéristiques**: Lion orange adorable qui rugit ou agite la patte\n\n### Grenouille\n**Nom**: Jumping Frog \n**Créateur**: Community \n**URL**: Cherchez \"jumping frog animation\" sur LottieFiles \n**Caractéristiques**: Grenouille verte qui saute joyeusement\n\n### Chat\n**Nom**: Sleeping Cat \n**Créateur**: Community \n**URL**: Cherchez \"cute sleeping cat\" sur LottieFiles \n**Caractéristiques**: Chat qui dort paisiblement (correspond à \"J'aime faire la sieste!\")\n\n### Poisson\n**Nom**: Swimming Fish \n**Créateur**: Community \n**URL**: Cherchez \"fish bubbles\" sur LottieFiles \n**Caractéristiques**: Poisson coloré qui nage avec des bulles\n\n### Papillon\n**Nom**: Flying Butterfly \n**Créateur**: Community \n**URL**: Cherchez \"colorful butterfly\" sur LottieFiles \n**Caractéristiques**: Papillon aux ailes arc-en-ciel qui vole\n\n---\n\n## ️ Dépannage\n\n### Problème: Animation ne s'affiche pas\n\n**Solution 1**: Vérifier le nom du fichier\n```bash\n# Les noms DOIVENT être during video playback\n window.addFlags(WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_KEEP_SCREEN_ON)\n \n binding = ActivityVideoPlayerBinding.inflate(layoutInflater)\n setContentView(binding.root)\n\n // Get video data from intent\n videoUrl = intent.getStringExtra(\"VIDEO_URL\") ?: \"\"\n videoTitle = intent.getStringExtra(\"VIDEO_TITLE\") ?: \"\"\n\n if (videoUrl.isEmpty()) {\n binding.progressBar.visibility = View.GONE\n binding.errorLayout.visibility = View.GONE\n }\n Player.STATE_ENDED -> {\n // Video ended, optionally show related videos or go back\n }\n {\n it.release()\n player = null\n }\n }\n\n override fun onPause() {\n super.onPause()\n player?.pause()\n }\n\n override fun onResume() {\n super.onResume()\n if (player?.playWhenReady == true) {\n "C:/Users/pc/AndroidStudioProjects/KidsLearning/VIDEO_LEARNING_GUIDE.md", "content": "# Guide Complet - Vidéos Éducatives\n\n## Vue d'Ensemble\n\nL'application Kids Learning inclut maintenant une section complète de **vidéos éducatives** pour apprendre les alphabets en **Français** et en **Arabe**! \n\n---\n\n## ✨ Fonctionnalités\n\n### Pour les Enfants:\n- **Vidéos éducatives** sur les alphabets\n- **Vidéos françaises**: Chansons, tutoriels d'écriture\n- **Vidéos arabes**: Sons, alphabets complets\n- **Lecteur intégré** avec contrôles adaptés aux enfants\n- **Interface colorée** et attractive\n- **Catégories multiples**: Chansons, Écriture, Sons, Tutoriels\n\n### Pour les Parents:\n- ✅ **Contenu éducatif** vérifié\n- ✅ **Navigation simple** pour les enfants\n- ✅ **Vidéos en français et arabe**\n- ✅ **Mode plein écran** disponible\n- ✅ **Contrôle parental** facile\n\n---\n\n## Structure Ajoutée\n\n### Nouveaux Fichiers Créés:\n\n```\napp/src/main/java/com/kidslearning/app/\n├── data/model/\n│ └── LearningVideo.kt ← Modèle de données vidéo\n├── ui/video/\n│ ├── VideoLearningActivity.kt ← Liste des vidéos\n│ ├── VideoPlayerActivity.kt ← Lecteur vidéo\n│ └── VideoAdapter.kt ← Adapter pour la liste\n\napp/src/main/res/layout/\n├── activity_video_learning.xml ← Layout liste vidéos\n├── activity_video_player.xml ← Layout lecteur\n├── item_video.xml ← Item de liste\n└── custom_player_controls.xml ← Contrôles personnalisés\n```\n\n### Dépendances Ajoutées:\n\n```kotlin\n// ExoPlayer for Video Learning\nimplementation(\"androidx.media3:media3-exoplayer:1.2.0\")\nimplementation(\"androidx.media3:media3-ui:1.2.0\")\nimplementation(\"androidx.media3:media3-common:1.2.0\")\n```\n\n---\n\n## Types de Vidéos Disponibles\n\n### 1. **Chansons de l'Alphabet** \n- Vidéos musicales pour apprendre en chantant\n- Durée: 3-5 minutes\n- Parfait pour mémoriser l'ordre des lettres\n\n### 2. **Comment Écrire** ✍️\n- Tutoriels pour écrire chaque lettre\n- Étapes détaillées\n- Durée: 8-12 minutes\n\n### 3. **Sons des Lettres** \n- Prononciation de chaque lettre\n- Exemples de mots\n- Durée: 5-7 minutes\n\n### 4. **Tutoriels Complets** \n- Alphabet complet A-Z ou ا-ي\n- Vidéo longue format\n- Durée: 12-20 minutes\n\n### 5. **Apprentissage Amusant** \n- Vidéos ludiques et interactives\n- Jeux et activités\n- Durée variable\n\n---\n\n## Comment Ajouter des Vraies Vidéos YouTube\n\n### Méthode 1: Vidéos YouTube (Recommandé)\n\n#### Étape 1: Trouver des Vidéos Éducatives\n\n**Pour l'Alphabet Français:**\n\nRecherchez sur YouTube:\n- \"chanson alphabet français enfants\"\n- \"apprendre écrire alphabet maternelle\"\n- \"ABC français pour enfants\"\n- \"lettres françaises prononciation\"\n\n**Vidéos Recommandées:**\n```\n• Alain Le Lait - L'alphabet\n https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=...\n \n• Monde des Titounis - ABC\n https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=...\n \n• Pinpin et Lili - Alphabet\n https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=...\n```\n\n**Pour l'Alphabet Arabe:**\n\nRecherchez sur YouTube:\n- \"أغنية الحروف العربية للأطفال\"\n- \"تعلم الحروف العربية\"\n- \"Arabic alphabet song\"\n- \"تعليم الكتابة للاطفال\"\n\n**Vidéos Recommandées:**\n```\n• أغنية الحروف العربية - Arabic Alphabet Song\n https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=...\n \n• تعلم الحروف العربية للأطفال\n https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=...\n \n• Arabic ABC for Kids\n https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=...\n```\n\n#### Étape 2: Obtenir l'URL de la Vidéo\n\nPour une vidéo YouTube:\n1. Ouvrez la vidéo sur YouTube\n2. Copiez l'URL (ex: `https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dQw4w9WgXcQ`)\n3. Ou clic droit → \"Copier l'URL de la vidéo\"\n\n#### Étape 3: Modifier le Code\n\nOuvrez: `app/src/main/java/com/kidslearning/app/data/model/LearningVideo.kt`\n\n**Pour les Vidéos Françaises:**\n\n```kotlin\nval frenchVideos = listOf(\n LearningVideo(\n id = 1,\n title = \"Chanson de l'Alphabet Français\",\n titleAr = \"أغنية الحروف الفرنسية\",\n description = \"Apprends l'alphabet français en chantant!\",\n descriptionAr = \"تعلم الحروف الفرنسية بالغناء!\",\n videoUrl = \"https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VOTRE_VIDEO_ID\", // ← REMPLACER ICI!\n thumbnailUrl = \"\",\n duration = \"3:45\",\n language = VideoLanguage.FRENCH,\n category = VideoCategory.ALPHABET_SONG\n ),\n // Ajouter plus de vidéos...\n)\n```\n\n**Pour les Vidéos Arabes:**\n\n```kotlin\nval arabicVideos = listOf(\n LearningVideo(\n id = 11,\n title = \"Chanson de l'Alphabet Arabe\",\n titleAr = \"أغنية الحروف العربية\",\n description = \"Apprends l'alphabet arabe en chantant!\",\n descriptionAr = \"تعلم الحروف العربية بالغناء!\",\n videoUrl = \"https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VOTRE_VIDEO_ID\", // ← REMPLACER ICI!\n thumbnailUrl = \"\",\n duration = \"4:10\",\n language = VideoLanguage.ARABIC,\n category = VideoCategory.ALPHABET_SONG\n ),\n // Ajouter plus de vidéos...\n)\n```\n\n---\n\n### Méthode 2: Vidéos Locales (Fichiers MP4)\n\n#### Avantages:\n- ✅ Fonctionne hors ligne\n- ✅ Pas besoin d'internet\n- ✅ Contrôle total du contenu\n\n#### Inconvénients:\n- ❌ Augmente la taille de l'APK\n- ❌ Doit télécharger/créer les vidéos\n\n#### Comment Faire:\n\n**Étape 1: Préparer les Vidéos**\n\n1. Téléchargez ou créez vos vidéos éducatives\n2. Format recommandé: MP4, H.264\n3. Résolution: 720p ou 1080p\n4. Taille: < 50 MB par vidéo\n\n**Étape 2: Placer dans le Projet**\n\n```\napp/src/main/res/raw/\n├── french_alphabet_song.mp4\n├── french_how_to_write.mp4\n├── arabic_alphabet_song.mp4\n└── arabic_how_to_write.mp4\n```\n\n**Étape 3: Modifier le Code**\n\n```kotlin\nLearningVideo(\n id = 1,\n title = \"Chanson de l'Alphabet Français\",\n titleAr = \"أغنية الحروف الفرنسية\",\n description = \"Apprends l'alphabet français en chantant!\",\n descriptionAr = \"تعلم الحروف الفرنسية بالغناء!\",\n videoUrl = \"android.resource://com.kidslearning.app/\" + R.raw.french_alphabet_song,\n thumbnailUrl = \"\",\n duration = \"3:45\",\n language = VideoLanguage.FRENCH,\n category = VideoCategory.ALPHABET_SONG,\n isOnline = false // ← IMPORTANT! Indique que c'est local\n)\n```\n\n---\n\n### Méthode 3: Vidéos Vimeo/Autres Plateformes\n\nSi vous hébergez sur Vimeo ou autre:\n\n```kotlin\nLearningVideo(\n videoUrl = \"https://vimeo.com/VOTRE_VIDEO_ID\",\n // ou\n videoUrl = \"https://player.vimeo.com/video/VOTRE_VIDEO_ID\",\n isOnline = true\n)\n```\n\n---\n\n## Personnalisation\n\n### Changer les Catégories\n\nDans `VideoCategory` enum:\n\n```kotlin\nenum class VideoCategory {\n ALPHABET_SONG, // Chansons\n HOW_TO_WRITE, // Écriture\n LETTER_SOUNDS, // Sons\n FULL_TUTORIAL, // Tutoriel complet\n FUN_LEARNING, // Apprentissage amusant\n // Ajoutez les vôtres:\n COUNTING, // Compter\n COLORS, // Couleurs\n SHAPES // Formes\n}\n```\n\n### Changer les Couleurs des Catégories\n\nDans `VideoAdapter.kt`:\n\n```kotlin\nval categoryColor = when (video.category) {\n VideoCategory.ALPHABET_SONG -> R.color.accent_yellow\n VideoCategory.HOW_TO_WRITE -> R.color.accent_pink\n VideoCategory.LETTER_SOUNDS -> R.color.accent_cyan\n VideoCategory.FULL_TUTORIAL -> R.color.accent_orange\n VideoCategory.FUN_LEARNING -> R.color.accent_purple\n // Vos nouvelles catégories:\n VideoCategory.COUNTING -> R.color.accent_green\n}\n```\n\n---\n\n## Utilisation dans l'App\n\n### Pour Accéder aux Vidéos:\n\n```\n1. Ouvrir l'app\n ↓\n2. Écran principal (MainActivity)\n ↓\n3. Cliquer sur le bouton violet \"Regarder des vidéos\" \n ↓\n4. Choisir onglet: \"Vidéos Françaises\" ou \"Vidéos Arabes\"\n ↓\n5. Sélectionner une vidéo dans la liste\n ↓\n6. La vidéo s'ouvre en plein écran\n ↓\n7. Contrôles: Play/Pause, Retour, Plein écran\n```\n\n### Fonctionnalités du Lecteur:\n\n- ▶️ **Play/Pause**: Bouton central\n- ⏪ **Retour arrière**: Bouton en haut à gauche\n- **Barre de progression**: Suivre la lecture\n- ⏱️ **Temps**: Temps actuel / Durée totale\n- ⛶ **Plein écran**: Bouton en bas à droite\n- **Auto-rotation**: Paysage pour plein écran\n\n---\n\n## Configuration Technique\n\n### ExoPlayer\n\nLe lecteur vidéo utilise **ExoPlayer** de Google:\n- ✅ Support YouTube (avec configuration)\n- ✅ Support MP4, WebM, MKV\n- ✅ Streaming adaptatif\n- ✅ Mise en cache automatique\n- ✅ Contrôles personnalisables\n\n### Permissions Requises\n\nDéjà configurées dans `AndroidManifest.xml`:\n\n```xml\n<uses-permission android:name=\"android.permission.INTERNET\" />\n<uses-permission android:name=\"android.permission.ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE\" />\n```\n\n### Activités Déclarées\n\n```xml\n<!-- Video Learning Activities -->\n<activity android:name=\".ui.video.VideoLearningActivity\" />\n<activity android:name=\".ui.video.VideoPlayerActivity\" />\n```\n\n---\n\n## Exemples de Vidéos à Ajouter\n\n### Vidéos Françaises Recommandées:\n\n#### 1. Chanson Alphabet\n```kotlin\nvideoUrl = \"https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Rb8hGgte6jY\" // Exemple\ntitle = \"ABC - Chanson de l'Alphabet\"\nduration = \"2:30\"\ncategory = VideoCategory.ALPHABET_SONG\n```\n\n#### 2. Comment Écrire les Lettres\n```kotlin\nvideoUrl = \"https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=...\" \ntitle = \"Apprendre à Écrire l'Alphabet\"\nduration = \"10:20\"\ncategory = VideoCategory.HOW_TO_WRITE\n```\n\n#### 3. Phonétique\n```kotlin\nvideoUrl = \"https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=...\"\ntitle = \"Sons des Lettres - A à Z\"\nduration = \"5:45\"\ncategory = VideoCategory.LETTER_SOUNDS\n```\n\n### Vidéos Arabes Recommandées:\n\n#### 1. Chanson Alphabet Arabe\n```kotlin\nvideoUrl = \"https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=...\" \ntitle = \"أغنية الحروف العربية\"\ntitleAr = \"أغنية الحروف العربية\"\nduration = \"3:15\"\ncategory = VideoCategory.ALPHABET_SONG\n```\n\n#### 2. The theme is supposed to be MaterialComponents, but I'm running into runtime errors that indicate I need AppCompat. It seems like using AppCompatDelegate with the wrong theme is causing this. However, the manifest specifies Theme.Black.NoTitleBar.Fullscreen for VideoPlayerActivity, which is not an AppCompat theme, hence the error. I need to adjust the manifest to use Theme.KidsLearning and create this new theme in themes.xml. Additionally, I'll check the PlayerView inflation error, as it might relate to mismatched controller layouts.**Addressing video player issues**

The linter was earlier complaining about something not being found, but during runtime, PlayerControlView should work if the dependency `media3-ui` is correctly added. I'm realizing that there’s also a big issue with VideoPlayerActivity showing errors for YouTube links, which need special handling. The easiest solution seems to be opening YouTube links directly in the YouTube app or browser using intents, or integrating the YouTube Player library instead of ExoPlayer. Given that users will likely use YouTube links, I should implement this by launching ACTION_VIEW if the URL contains YouTube.**Updating video player functionality**

I’ll revise the approach for handling YouTube videos by using `startActivity(Intent(Intent.ACTION_VIEW, Uri.parse(videoUrl)))` instead of showing an error and returning. It's essential to ensure there’s a fallback for when no app is available—perhaps using a custom tab via `androidx.browser:browser`. For direct mp4 links, I'll continue using ExoPlayer. Currently, the LearningVideo repository has placeholder URLs that won’t play, so I wonder if I should replace them with actual links or just provide helpful messages while asking the user for video IDs instead. I'll also correct attributes and IDs in `activity_video_player.xml` to align with `androidx.media3.ui.PlayerView` and patch the manifest with the new theme.**Adjusting control attributes**

I'm considering removing the custom control attribute `?attr/selectableItemBackgroundBorderless` and just using a plain transparent background to avoid any issues with the theme. However, it seems that with the correct theme in place, it might not be a problem after all. I also noticed that the error might relate to configuration changes, which could be acceptable. ### Cause du crash
Ton `VideoPlayerActivity` utilisait le thème `@android:style/Theme.Black.NoTitleBar.Fullscreen` (pas compatible AppCompat/Material), donc `PlayerView` + tes `ImageButton` (ex: `?attr/selectableItemBackgroundBorderless`) crashaient à l’inflation.

### Fix appliqué
- **Manifest**: `VideoPlayerActivity` utilise maintenant `@style/Theme.KidsLearning.Fullscreen` (compatible AppCompat/Material).
- **themes.xml**: ajout de `Theme.KidsLearning.Fullscreen`.
- **VideoPlayerActivity**:
 - étend `BaseActivity` (cohérence avec le reste de l’app),
 - si l’URL est **YouTube**, on ouvre la vidéo via l’app YouTube / navigateur (ExoPlayer ne lit pas les liens YouTube “page”).
- **VideoAdapter**: correction d’un bug de compilation (`position` n’existait pas dans `bind()`).

### À faire
- **Rebuild** dans Android Studio: **Build → Rebuild Project**, puis relance et reteste l’ouverture d’une vidéo.

+package com.kidslearning.app.utils
+
+import android.content.Context
+import android.media.MediaPlayer
+import java.io.IOException
+
+/**
+ * Background Music Player for playing relaxing/fun music while children learn
+ * Perfect for creating an exciting and motivating learning environment
+ */
+class BackgroundMusicPlayer(private val context: Context) {
+
+ private var mediaPlayer: MediaPlayer? = null
+ private var isLooping = true
+ private var currentVolume = 0.5f // 50% volume for background music
+
+ /**
+ * Available music tracks for kids learning
+ */
+ enum class MusicTrack(val resourceName: String, val displayName: String) {
+ HAPPY_LEARNING("happy_learning_music", "Happy Learning"),
+ GENTLE_PIANO("gentle_piano_music", "Gentle Piano"),
+ UPLIFTING_MELODY("uplifting_melody", "Uplifting Melody"),
+ CHEERFUL_BELLS("cheerful_bells", "Cheerful Bells"),
+ RAINBOW_NOTES("rainbow_notes", "Rainbow Notes");
+
+ companion object {
+ fun fromString(value: String?): MusicTrack {
+ return try {
+ MusicTrack.valueOf(value?.uppercase() ?: "HAPPY_LEARNING")
+ } catch (e: IllegalArgumentException) {
+ HAPPY_LEARNING
+ }
+ }
+ }
+ }
+
+ /**
+ * Start playing background music
+ */
+ fun startMusic(track: MusicTrack = MusicTrack.HAPPY_LEARNING, volume: Float = 0.5f) {
+ try {
+ release()
+ currentVolume = volume.coerceIn(0f, 1f)
+
+ val resId =
+ context.resources.getIdentifier(track.resourceName, "raw", context.packageName)
+
+ if (resId != 0) {
+ mediaPlayer = MediaPlayer.create(context, resId)
+ mediaPlayer?.apply {
+ setVolume(currentVolume, currentVolume)
+ isLooping = this@BackgroundMusicPlayer.isLooping
+ start()
+ }
+ } else {
+ // Try loading from assets as fallback
+ playFromAssets("music/${track.resourceName}.mp3", volume)
+ }
+ } catch (e: Exception) {
+ e.printStackTrace()
+ }
+ }
+
+ /**
+ * Play from assets folder
+ */
+ private fun playFromAssets(fileName: String, volume: Float) {
+ try {
+ val afd = context.assets.openFd(fileName)
+ mediaPlayer = MediaPlayer().apply {
+ setDataSource(afd.fileDescriptor, afd.startOffset, afd.length)
+ prepare()
+ setVolume(volume, volume)
+ isLooping = this@BackgroundMusicPlayer.isLooping
+ start()
+ }
+ afd.close()
+ } catch (e: IOException) {
+ e.printStackTrace()
+ }
+ }
+
+ /**
+ * Pause the background music
+ */
+ fun pauseMusic() {
+ try {
+ mediaPlayer?.let {
+ if (it.isPlaying) {
+ it.pause()
+ }
+ }
+ } catch (e: Exception) {
+ e.printStackTrace()
+ }
+ }
+
+ /**
+ * Resume the background music
+ */
+ fun resumeMusic() {
+ try {
+ mediaPlayer?.let {
+ if (!it.isPlaying) {
+ it.start()
+ }
+ }
+ } catch (e: Exception) {
+ e.printStackTrace()
+ }
+ }
+
+ /**
+ * Stop and release the music player
+ */
+ fun stopMusic() {
+ try {
+ mediaPlayer?.let {
+ if (it.isPlaying) {
+ it.stop()
+ }
+ it.release()
+ }
+ } catch (e: IllegalStateException) {
+ // Player already released
+ } finally {
+ mediaPlayer = null
+ }
+ }
+
+ /**
+ * Release resources
+ */
+ fun release() {
+ try {
+ mediaPlayer?.apply {
+ try {
+ if (isPlaying) {
+ stop()
+ }
+ } catch (e: IllegalStateException) {
+ // Already stopped
+ }
+ release()
+ }
+ } catch (e: Exception) {
+ e.printStackTrace()
+ } finally {
+ mediaPlayer = null
+ }
+ }
+
+ /**
+ * Check if music is currently playing
+ */
+ fun isPlaying(): Boolean {
+ return mediaPlayer?.isPlaying ?: false
+ }
+
+ /**
+ * Set volume (0f to 1f)
+ */
+ fun setVolume(volume: Float) {
+ currentVolume = volume.coerceIn(0f, 1f)
+ mediaPlayer?.setVolume(currentVolume, currentVolume)
+ }
+
+ /**
+ * Get current volume
+ */
+ fun getVolume(): Float {
+ return currentVolume
+ }
+
+ /**
+ * Set whether music should loop
+ */
+ fun setLooping(loop: Boolean) {
+ isLooping = loop
+ mediaPlayer?.isLooping = loop
+ }
+
+ /**
+ * Check if music is set to loop
+ */
+ fun isLooping(): Boolean {
+ return isLooping
+ }
+}
+

+# Music Setup Guide for Kids Learning App
+
+This guide explains how to add background music files to the Kids Learning app so children can enjoy
+exciting learning experiences with music!
+
+## Overview
+
+The app now includes a **BackgroundMusicPlayer** system that plays relaxing and energizing music
+while kids are tracing letters and learning. Children can toggle the music on/off with the music
+button in the drawing screen.
+
+## Music Files Location
+
+Place your music files in the following directory:
+
+```
+app/src/main/res/raw/
+```
+
+## Supported Music Formats
+
+- **MP3** (recommended - best compatibility)
+- **WAV**
+- **OGG**
+
+## Available Music Tracks
+
+The system supports 5 different music tracks:
+
+1. **happy_learning_music** (currently used by default)
+ - Happy, uplifting melody perfect for motivation
+
+2. **gentle_piano_music**
+ - Calm, soothing piano for focused learning
+
+3. **uplifting_melody**
+ - Energetic instrumental for excitement
+
+4. **cheerful_bells**
+ - Light, playful bell sounds
+
+5. **rainbow_notes**
+ - Colorful, imaginative music
+
+## How to Add Music Files
+
+### Step 1: Find or Create Music Files
+
+You can:
+
+- Use royalty-free music from sites like:
+ - [FreeMusic Archive](https://freemusicarchive.org/)
+ - [Incompetech](https://incompetech.com/)
+ - [YouTube Audio Library](https://www.youtube.com/audiolibrary)
+- Use child-friendly music collections
+- Create your own custom melodies
+
+### Step 2: Optimize the Audio Files
+
+For mobile apps, optimize your music files:
+
+- **Bitrate**: 128 kbps (good balance of quality and size)
+- **Sample rate**: 44.1 kHz
+- **Duration**: 30-120 seconds recommended (will loop)
+
+Use tools like:
+
+- FFmpeg
+- Audacity (free)
+- MP3 converters
+
+**Example using FFmpeg:**
+
+```bash
+ffmpeg -i input_music.mp3 -b:a 128k -ar 44100 happy_learning_music.mp3
+```
+
+### Step 3: Place Files in Project
+
+1. In Android Studio, go to: `app/src/main/res/raw/`
+2. Right-click → New → File
+3. Name it exactly: `happy_learning_music.mp3` (or other track name)
+4. Copy/paste your optimized audio file
+
+Or manually copy files to the folder via file explorer.
+
+### Step 4: Verify Resource Names
+
+The resource names in code MUST match the file names exactly:
+
+```kotlin
+enum class MusicTrack(val resourceName: String, val displayName: String) {
+ HAPPY_LEARNING("happy_learning_music", "Happy Learning"),
+ GENTLE_PIANO("gentle_piano_music", "Gentle Piano"),
+ UPLIFTING_MELODY("uplifting_melody", "Uplifting Melody"),
+ CHEERFUL_BELLS("cheerful_bells", "Cheerful Bells"),
+ RAINBOW_NOTES("rainbow_notes", "Rainbow Notes");
+}
+```
+
+**File naming rule**: Remove `.mp3` extension from the enum value.
+
+## How the System Works
+
+### Music Playback
+
+- Music starts automatically when the child enters the drawing screen
+- Default volume: **50%** (doesn't drown out letter pronunciation)
+- Music **loops continuously** while drawing
+- Perfect for keeping children engaged and excited to learn!
+
+### User Controls
+
+- **Music Button** (cyan colored) in the toolbar toggles music on/off
+- Shows toast notifications: "Musique en cours..." / "Musique en pause"
+- Music pauses when activity is paused (phone locked, switched apps)
+- Music resumes when returning to the activity
+
+## Code Implementation Details
+
+### BackgroundMusicPlayer Class
+
+Located in: `app/src/main/java/com/kidslearning/app/utils/BackgroundMusicPlayer.kt`
+
+**Key Methods:**
+
+```kotlin
+// Start playing with specific track and volume (0-1)
+startMusic(track: MusicTrack, volume: Float)
+
+// Pause/Resume
+pauseMusic()
+resumeMusic()
+
+// Stop and release
+stopMusic()
+release()
+
+// Control
+setVolume(volume: Float)
+setLooping(loop: Boolean)
+isPlaying(): Boolean
+```
+
+### DrawingActivity Integration
+
+The music player is integrated into `DrawingActivity`:
+
+- Initialized in `onCreate()`
+- Started automatically with `startBackgroundMusic()`
+- Toggled via `toggleBackgroundMusic()` when user clicks music button
+- Paused in `onPause()`
+- Released in `onDestroy()`
+
+## Customizing Music
+
+### Change Default Track
+
+Edit `DrawingActivity.kt`:
+
+```kotlin
+private fun startBackgroundMusic() {
+ backgroundMusicPlayer.startMusic(
+ track = BackgroundMusicPlayer.MusicTrack.GENTLE_PIANO, // Change this
+ volume = 0.5f
+ )
+}
+```
+
+### Change Default Volume
+
+```kotlin
+backgroundMusicPlayer.startMusic(
+ track = BackgroundMusicPlayer.MusicTrack.HAPPY_LEARNING,
+ volume = 0.7f // 70% volume
+)
+```
+
+### Change Volume Dynamically
+
+```kotlin
+backgroundMusicPlayer.setVolume(0.3f) // 30% volume
+```
+
+## Troubleshooting
+
+### Music doesn't play
+
+1. ✅ Check file exists in `app/src/main/res/raw/`
+2. ✅ File name matches exactly in `MusicTrack` enum
+3. ✅ File is in supported format (MP3, WAV, OGG)
+4. ✅ Device has volume enabled (not muted)
+5. ✅ Try rebuilding the project
+
+### Music is too loud/quiet
+
+- Adjust volume in `startMusic()` call (0f = silent, 1f = max)
+- Current default is 0.5f = 50%
+
+### Music cuts off when app switches
+
+- This is expected behavior - music pauses in `onPause()`
+- Resumes when returning to app in `onResume()`
+
+### File size too large
+
+- Compress using FFmpeg (see Step 2)
+- Target: 200-500 KB per file
+- Optimize bitrate to 128 kbps
+
+## Best Practices for Kids Learning Music
+
+✅ **Good Music Characteristics:**
+
+- Uplifting and positive tone
+- No vocals (or soft, gentle vocals only)
+- 60-100 BPM tempo (not too fast, not too slow)
+- No sudden loud noises
+- Repeatable/loopable structure
+
+✅ **Good Genres:**
+
+- Instrumental pop
+- Classical/Piano
+- Lo-fi hip hop
+- Ambient/Chill
+- World music
+- Children's music collections
+
+❌ **Avoid:**
+
+- Heavy metal or aggressive music
+- Music with lyrics that distract from learning
+- Extremely long tracks (memory intensive)
+- Poor audio quality
+
+## Adding Music to Other Activities
+
+To add background music to other learning activities:
+
+```kotlin
+private lateinit var backgroundMusicPlayer: BackgroundMusicPlayer
+
+override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
+ super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
+ // ... other code ...
+ 
+ backgroundMusicPlayer = BackgroundMusicPlayer(this)
+ backgroundMusicPlayer.startMusic(BackgroundMusicPlayer.MusicTrack.HAPPY_LEARNING, 0.5f)
+}
+
+override fun onDestroy() {
+ super.onDestroy()
+ backgroundMusicPlayer.release()
+}
+```
+
+## Resources
+
+### Free Music Sources
+
+- [FreeMusic Archive](https://freemusicarchive.org/) - Creative Commons music
+- [Incompetech](https://incompetech.com/) - Royalty-free instrumental
+- [YouTube Audio Library](https://www.youtube.com/audiolibrary) - Free for YouTube creators
+- [BenSound](https://www.bensound.com/) - Uplifting background music
+
+### Audio Editing Tools
+
+- [Audacity](https://www.audacityteam.org/) - Free audio editor
+- [FFmpeg](https://ffmpeg.org/) - Command-line audio tool
+- [Online-Convert](https://online-convert.com/) - Quick conversions
+
+## Questions?
+
+For more details on the BackgroundMusicPlayer implementation, see the inline documentation in:
+`app/src/main/java/com/kidslearning/app/utils/BackgroundMusicPlayer.kt`
+

+# Music Implementation Summary
+
+## What's New
+
+Your Kids Learning app now has **exciting background music** that plays while children are learning
+to write letters! This keeps kids engaged, motivated, and happy to learn.
+
+## What Was Added
+
+### 1. **BackgroundMusicPlayer Utility**
+
+- Location: `app/src/main/java/com/kidslearning/app/utils/BackgroundMusicPlayer.kt`
+- Handles all music playback, volume control, and looping
+- Supports 5 different music tracks
+
+### 2. **Updated Drawing Activity**
+
+- Location: `app/src/main/java/com/kidslearning/app/ui/drawing/DrawingActivity.kt`
+- Music starts automatically when child enters drawing screen
+- Music pauses when app is paused, resumes when app returns
+- Integrated music toggle button (cyan button next to sound button)
+
+### 3. **New UI Music Button**
+
+- Cyan colored button in the drawing screen toolbar
+- Positioned between letter display and sound button
+- Allows child to pause/resume music at any time
+- Shows friendly notifications
+
+### 4. **Localization Support**
+
+- French strings added to `values/strings.xml`
+- Arabic translations added to `values-ar/strings.xml`
+- Music control messages in both languages
+
+### 5. **Comprehensive Documentation**
+
+- `MUSIC_SETUP_GUIDE.md` - Complete guide for developers
+- Updated README files with music instructions
+
+## How It Works
+
+```
+Child enters drawing activity
+ ↓
+Music starts playing automatically (happy_learning_music.mp3)
+ ↓
+Volume set to 50% (background level, doesn't drown out letter sounds)
+ ↓
+Music loops continuously while child is learning
+ ↓
+Child can toggle music ON/OFF with the cyan music button
+ ↓
+When child leaves activity, music pauses
+ ↓
+If child returns, music resumes from where it left off
+```
+
+## Quick Start
+
+### For Developers
+
+1. **Add music files** to `app/src/main/res/raw/`:
+ - Required: `happy_learning_music.mp3`
+ - Optional: `gentle_piano_music.mp3`, `uplifting_melody.mp3`, `cheerful_bells.mp3`,
+ `rainbow_notes.mp3`
+
+2. **Rebuild and run** - Music will play automatically!
+
+3. For detailed instructions, see: `MUSIC_SETUP_GUIDE.md`
+
+### For Users
+
+- Children will see a cyan **music button** in the toolbar
+- Click it to pause/resume music while learning
+- Music helps them stay excited and motivated!
+
+## File Changes
+
+### New Files Created:
+
+- ✅ `app/src/main/java/com/kidslearning/app/utils/BackgroundMusicPlayer.kt`
+- ✅ `MUSIC_SETUP_GUIDE.md`
+- ✅ `MUSIC_IMPLEMENTATION_SUMMARY.md` (this file)
+
+### Modified Files:
+
+- ✅ `app/src/main/java/com/kidslearning/app/ui/drawing/DrawingActivity.kt`
+- ✅ `app/src/main/res/layout/activity_drawing.xml`
+- ✅ `app/src/main/res/values/strings.xml`
+- ✅ `app/src/main/res/values-ar/strings.xml`
+- ✅ `app/src/main/assets/sounds/README.txt`
+
+## Features
+
+✨ **What Kids Get:**
+
+- Uplifting background music while learning
+- More excitement and motivation to learn
+- Better engagement during writing practice
+- Can toggle music on/off anytime
+- Works in French and Arabic
+
+⚙️ **Technical Features:**
+
+- Volume control (adjustable 0-100%)
+- Auto-looping for continuous playback
+- Graceful pause/resume on app state changes
+- Memory-efficient audio handling
+- Fallback if music files not available (app still works)
+- Exception handling for all audio operations
+
+## Default Music Settings
+
+- **Default Track**: Happy Learning (motivating, uplifting)
+- **Default Volume**: 50% (balanced background music)
+- **Looping**: Enabled (plays continuously)
+- **Auto Start**: Yes (starts when activity opens)
+
+## Customization Options
+
+Want to change the default music? Edit `DrawingActivity.kt`:
+
+```kotlin
+// Change which track plays by default
+backgroundMusicPlayer.startMusic(
+ track = BackgroundMusicPlayer.MusicTrack.GENTLE_PIANO, // or another track
+ volume = 0.5f
+)
+
+// Change volume level
+volume = 0.3f // 30% volume
+volume = 0.7f // 70% volume
+```
+
+## Next Steps for Developers
+
+1. Read `MUSIC_SETUP_GUIDE.md` for complete setup instructions
+2. Find free music from:
+ - Incompetech.com (royalty-free instrumental)
+ - FreeMusic Archive (Creative Commons)
+ - YouTube Audio Library
+3. Optimize audio files (128 kbps MP3 recommended)
+4. Add files to `app/src/main/res/raw/`
+5. Rebuild project - Done! 
+
+## Troubleshooting
+
+**Q: Music doesn't play?**
+A: Check that `happy_learning_music.mp3` exists in `app/src/main/res/raw/`
+
+**Q: Can I change the volume?**
+A: Yes! See "Customization Options" above
+
+**Q: Does the app work without music?**
+A: Yes! The app includes graceful fallbacks. Music is optional.
+
+**Q: Can I add music to other activities?**
+A: Yes! See `MUSIC_SETUP_GUIDE.md` for integration examples.
+
+## Questions?
+
+Check these files for answers:
+
+- `MUSIC_SETUP_GUIDE.md` - Detailed setup and customization guide
+- `BackgroundMusicPlayer.kt` - Inline code documentation
+- `DrawingActivity.kt` - Integration example
+
+Enjoy building an even more exciting learning experience! ✨
+

+ backgroundMusicPlayer = BackgroundMusicPlayer(this)
+
+2. Start music:
+ backgroundMusicPlayer.startMusic(
+ track = BackgroundMusicPlayer.MusicTrack.HAPPY_LEARNING,
+ volume = 0.5f
+ )
+
+3. Control music:
+ backgroundMusicPlayer.pauseMusic()
+ backgroundMusicPlayer.resumeMusic()
+ backgroundMusicPlayer.setVolume(0.7f)
+
+4. Clean up:
+ backgroundMusicPlayer.release()
+
+
+NEXT STEPS
+==========
+
+For Developers:
+1. Read MUSIC_SETUP_GUIDE.md for detailed instructions
+2. Obtain license-free music files from:
+ - Incompetech.com
+ - FreeMusic Archive
+ - YouTube Audio Library
+3. Optimize audio files (128 kbps MP3)
+4. Add to app/src/main/res/raw/
+5. Rebuild and test
+
+For Users:
+- Just rebuild and run - music will play automatically!
+- Click cyan music button to toggle music on/off
+- Enjoy a more exciting learning experience! ✨
+
+
+TROUBLESHOOTING QUICK REFERENCE
+================================
+
+Problem: No music playing
+→ Check happy_learning_music.mp3 exists in app/src/main/res/raw/
+
+Problem: Music too loud/quiet 
+→ Adjust volume in startBackgroundMusic() method
+
+Problem: Music stops when app pauses
+→ This is expected - music auto-resumes when returning
+
+Problem: File not found error
+→ Ensure filename matches exactly: "happy_learning_music.mp3"
+
+Problem: App crashes
+→ Try with try-catch - music is optional, won't crash app
+
+
+CREATED BY
+==========
+Kids Learning App Development Team
+ Making learning fun and musical! ✨

+# Quick Music Setup (5 Minutes)
+
+Get background music playing in your Kids Learning app in just 5 minutes!
+
+## ⏱️ 5-Minute Setup
+
+### Step 1: Get a Music File (1 minute)
+
+Choose one of these:
+
+- Download from [Incompetech.com](https://incompetech.com/) (recommended - totally free)
+- Use [YouTube Audio Library](https://www.youtube.com/audiolibrary)
+- Find on [FreeMusic Archive](https://freemusicarchive.org/)
+
+Choose something **uplifting and cheerful** for kids!
+
+### Step 2: Name the File (1 minute)
+
+Rename your file to: **`happy_learning_music.mp3`**
+
+(Must be exactly this name!)
+
+### Step 3: Place in Project (1 minute)
+
+Copy the file to: `app/src/main/res/raw/`
+
+In Android Studio:
+
+1. Right-click: `app/src/main/res/raw/`
+2. Click: Paste
+3. Or drag-drop the file
+
+### Step 4: Rebuild Project (2 minutes)
+
+In Android Studio:
+
+```
+Build → Clean Project
+Build → Rebuild Project
+```
+
+### Step 5: Run & Enjoy! (Done!)
+
+```
+Run → Run 'app'
+```
+
+Open drawing activity and hear music! 
+
+## Complete File List
+
+Need more music tracks? Add to `app/src/main/res/raw/`:
+
+| Filename | Status | Purpose |
+|----------|--------|---------|
+| `happy_learning_music.mp3` | **REQUIRED** | Default - Plays automatically |
+| `gentle_piano_music.mp3` | Optional | Calm, focused learning |
+| `uplifting_melody.mp3` | Optional | Energetic, inspiring |
+| `cheerful_bells.mp3` | Optional | Playful, whimsical |
+| `rainbow_notes.mp3` | Optional | Imaginative, magical |
+
+**Only need the first one to get started!**
+
+## ️ Quick Control Options
+
+### Change Default Music
+
+Edit: `app/src/main/java/com/kidslearning/app/ui/drawing/DrawingActivity.kt`
+
+Line ~129, change the track name:
+
+```kotlin
+// Change to one of these:
+BackgroundMusicPlayer.MusicTrack.HAPPY_LEARNING // Default - uplifting
+BackgroundMusicPlayer.MusicTrack.GENTLE_PIANO // Calm
+BackgroundMusicPlayer.MusicTrack.UPLIFTING_MELODY // Energetic
+BackgroundMusicPlayer.MusicTrack.CHEERFUL_BELLS // Playful
+BackgroundMusicPlayer.MusicTrack.RAINBOW_NOTES // Imaginative
+```
+
+### Change Music Volume
+
+Line ~130, change volume (0f to 1f):
+
+```kotlin
+volume = 0.5f // 50% - Current default (good balance)
+volume = 0.3f // 30% - Quiet background
+volume = 0.7f // 70% - Louder, more prominent
+volume = 1.0f // 100% - Full volume
+```
+
+## ✅ Verification Checklist
+
+- [ ] Downloaded or created a music file
+- [ ] Named it `happy_learning_music.mp3`
+- [ ] Placed in `app/src/main/res/raw/` folder
+- [ ] Cleaned project (`Build → Clean Project`)
+- [ ] Rebuilt project (`Build → Rebuild Project`)
+- [ ] Ran the app
+- [ ] Entered drawing activity and heard music!
+- [ ] Clicked cyan music button to toggle music
+
+## What You Should Hear
+
+When you open the drawing screen:
+
+- Music starts automatically
+- Volume is at background level (50%)
+- Music loops continuously
+- Cyan button lets child pause/resume music
+
+## Quick Troubleshooting
+
+| Problem | Solution |
+|---------|----------|
+| No music | File must be in `app/src/main/res/raw/` |
+| Wrong filename | Rename to `happy_learning_music.mp3` exactly |
+| Still no music | Clean & Rebuild project, then restart app |
+| App crashes | Check filename spelling - it must match exactly |
+| Music too loud | Change `volume = 0.5f` to `0.3f` in code |
+| Music too quiet | Change `volume = 0.5f` to `0.7f` in code |
+
+## What Kids See
+
+1. Opens drawing activity
+2. Music starts automatically!
+3. Sees cyan music button in toolbar
+4. Can click to pause/resume music anytime
+5. Practices writing letters with happy background music
+6. Leaves activity, returns later
+7. Music continues from where it left off
+
+Perfect for keeping kids excited about learning! 
+
+## Need More Details?
+
+- **MUSIC_SETUP_GUIDE.md** - Complete technical guide
+- **MUSIC_FEATURE_OVERVIEW.txt** - Visual overview
+- **MUSIC_IMPLEMENTATION_SUMMARY.md** - What was built
+
+## That's It!
+
+You now have background music in your Kids Learning app! ✨
+
+Questions? Check the documentation files above or the source code comments in:
+`app/src/main/java/com/kidslearning/app/utils/BackgroundMusicPlayer.kt`
+
+Happy learning! 
+

+# Onboarding Animations - SUPER ATTRACTIVE UPGRADE! ✨
+
+## Overview
+
+The onboarding pages have been completely upgraded with **AMAZING, eye-catching animal Lottie
+animations** that are super attractive and engaging for kids! Every single page is now more
+colorful, bigger, and more exciting!
+
+---
+
+## What's NEW and IMPROVED
+
+### 1. **BRAND NEW Lottie Animal Animations** 
+
+All 5 onboarding pages now feature **high-quality, adorable animal Lottie animations** from
+LottieFiles:
+
+| Page | Animal | Animation | What Kids See |
+|------|--------|-----------|---------------|
+| **1** | **Lion** | Roaring Lion | Adorable, colorful, king of the jungle! |
+| **2** | **Frog** | Jumping Frog | Happy, bouncy, bright green frog! |
+| **3** | **Cat** | Playing Cat | Cute, playful, sweet kitty! |
+| **4** | **Fish** | Swimming Fish | Colorful fish with bubbles! |
+| **5** | **Butterfly** | Flying Butterfly | Beautiful rainbow-winged butterfly! |
+
+### 2. **BIGGER Animation Cards** 
+
+- **Previous size**: 250x250 dp
+- **NEW SIZE**: **280x280 dp**
+- **Result**: 12% BIGGER for maximum impact!
+- Thicker stroke border: 8dp (was 6dp)
+- Higher elevation: 24dp (was 20dp) - More depth!
+
+### 3. **Colorful Themed Backgrounds** 
+
+Each page now has its own **unique soft color background** that matches the animal:
+
+```
+Page 1 (Lion): Soft Yellow/Cream (#FFF9E6) + Orange Border
+Page 2 (Frog): Soft Mint Green (#E6F9F0) + Green Border 
+Page 3 (Cat): Soft Pink (#FFE6F2) + Pink Border
+Page 4 (Fish): Soft Cyan (#E6F9FF) + Cyan Border
+Page 5 (Butterfly): Soft Purple (#F2E6FF) + Purple Border
+```
+
+Each page feels completely different and special!
+
+### 4. **Enhanced Text Styling** 
+
+**Titles:**
+
+- Font size increased: 34sp → **38sp**
+- Better letter spacing: 0.02
+- Stronger shadow for depth
+- More prominent and fun!
+
+**Descriptions:**
+
+- Font size increased: 18sp → **22sp**
+- Added subtle shadow for readability
+- Clearer and easier to read!
+
+### 5. **Bigger Sparkles & Decorations** ✨
+
+- Sparkle 1: 40dp → **48dp**
+- Sparkle 2: 32dp → **44dp**
+- More visible and eye-catching!
+- Added alpha values for perfect visibility
+
+### 6. **Better Animation Performance** ⚡
+
+- Animation speed optimized: 0.7x → **0.8x** (more energy!)
+- Added smooth entrance fade-in effect
+- Scale animation on appear (1.1x → 1.0x bounce)
+- Infinite loop for continuous fun
+
+### 7. **Backup Animations** 
+
+Each animal has a **backup Lottie animation** that loads if the primary fails:
+
+- Dog, Bird, Rabbit, Duck, Elephant
+- Ensures animations always work!
+
+---
+
+## Files Modified
+
+### 1. **OnboardingAdapter.kt**
+
+- ✅ Updated with 5 new Lottie animation URLs
+- ✅ Added 5 backup Lottie animation URLs
+- ✅ Enhanced animation setup with entrance effects
+- ✅ Added colorful background colors for each page
+- ✅ Improved animation speed and looping
+- ✅ Added scale and fade entrance animation
+
+### 2. **item_onboarding_page.xml**
+
+- ✅ Increased animation card size (250dp → 280dp)
+- ✅ Increased card elevation (20dp → 24dp)
+- ✅ Thicker stroke border (6dp → 8dp)
+- ✅ Bigger title text (34sp → 38sp)
+- ✅ Bigger description text (18sp → 22sp)
+- ✅ Bigger sparkles (40dp/32dp → 48dp/44dp)
+- ✅ Enhanced padding and spacing
+- ✅ Added text shadows for depth
+
+---
+
+## Visual Impact Summary
+
+### BEFORE vs AFTER
+
+**BEFORE:**
+
+- ❌ Smaller animations (250x250)
+- ❌ All white backgrounds
+- ❌ Smaller text (34sp/18sp)
+- ❌ Basic animations
+- ❌ Standard speed
+
+**AFTER:**
+
+- ✅ BIGGER animations (280x280) - **12% larger!**
+- ✅ Colorful themed backgrounds per animal
+- ✅ BIGGER text (38sp/22sp) - **11-22% larger!**
+- ✅ Enhanced animations with entrance effects
+- ✅ Optimized speed for excitement
+- ✅ Bigger decorations (48dp sparkles!)
+- ✅ Unique color theme per page
+- ✅ Better shadows and depth
+
+---
+
+## Color Scheme Per Page
+

+// Lottie Animation Properties

+// Entrance Animation

+# Guide d'Installation des Animations Lottie pour les Animaux
+
+## Vue d'Ensemble
+
+Ce guide vous montre comment télécharger et installer les **VRAIES** animations Lottie d'animaux qui
+correspondent EXACTEMENT au contenu de chaque page d'onboarding!
+
+---
+
+## Les 5 Animations Requises
+
+| Page | Animal | Fichier | Description |
+|------|--------|---------|-------------|
+| 1 | **LION** | `lion.json` | Lion rugissant ou agitant la patte |
+| 2 | **GRENOUILLE** | `frog.json` | Grenouille qui saute joyeusement |
+| 3 | **CHAT** | `cat.json` | Chat mignon qui joue |
+| 4 | **POISSON** | `fish.json` | Poisson qui nage avec des bulles |
+| 5 | **PAPILLON** | `butterfly.json` | Papillon qui vole magnifiquement |
+
+---
+
+## Structure des Dossiers
+
+Créez cette structure dans votre projet:
+
+```
+app/src/main/assets/
+├── alphabet_data.json
+├── sounds/
+│ └── README.txt
+└── lottie/ ← CRÉER CE DOSSIER!
+ ├── lion.json ← Télécharger
+ ├── frog.json ← Télécharger
+ ├── cat.json ← Télécharger
+ ├── fish.json ← Télécharger
+ └── butterfly.json ← Télécharger
+```
+
+---
+
+## MÉTHODE 1: Téléchargement Rapide depuis LottieFiles.com
+
+### Étape 1: Créer le Dossier
+
+1. Ouvrez Android Studio
+2. Naviguez vers: `app/src/main/assets/`
+3. Clic droit → **New** → **Directory**
+4. Nommez-le: `lottie`
+
+### Étape 2: Télécharger les Animations
+
+Pour chaque animation, suivez ces étapes:
+
+#### LION (Page 1)
+
+1. **Allez sur**: https://lottiefiles.com/free-animations/lion
+2. **Cherchez**: "cute lion" ou "cartoon lion"
+3. **Choisissez**: Une animation colorée et adorable
+4. **Cliquez**: "Download" → "Lottie JSON"
+5. **Renommez**: le fichier en `lion.json`
+6. **Placez**: dans `app/src/main/assets/lottie/`
+
+**Suggestions d'animations:**
+
+- **Roaring Lion** - Lion qui rugit de façon mignonne
+- **Waving Lion** - Lion qui fait signe
+- **Sitting Lion** - Lion assis majestueusement
+- **Lion Face** - Visage de lion expressif
+
+**URL directe recommandée**:
+
+```
+https://lottiefiles.com/animations/lion-roar
+https://lottiefiles.com/animations/cute-lion
+```
+
+#### GRENOUILLE (Page 2)
+
+1. **Allez sur**: https://lottiefiles.com/free-animations/frog
+2. **Cherchez**: "jumping frog" ou "cute frog"
+3. **Choisissez**: Grenouille qui saute ou qui fait Coâ Coâ!
+4. **Téléchargez**: Lottie JSON
+5. **Renommez**: en `frog.json`
+6. **Placez**: dans `app/src/main/assets/lottie/`
+
+**Suggestions d'animations:**
+
+- **Jumping Frog** - Grenouille qui saute
+- **Happy Frog** - Grenouille joyeuse
+- **Green Frog** - Grenouille verte classique
+- **Frog on Lily Pad** - Grenouille sur nénuphar
+
+**URL directe recommandée**:
+
+```
+https://lottiefiles.com/animations/frog-jump
+https://lottiefiles.com/animations/cute-frog
+```
+
+#### CHAT (Page 3)
+
+1. **Allez sur**: https://lottiefiles.com/free-animations/cat
+2. **Cherchez**: "cute cat" ou "playful cat"
+3. **Choisissez**: Chat mignon qui joue ou dort
+4. **Téléchargez**: Lottie JSON
+5. **Renommez**: en `cat.json`
+6. **Placez**: dans `app/src/main/assets/lottie/`
+
+**Suggestions d'animations:**
+
+- **Playing Cat** - Chat qui joue
+- **Sleeping Cat** - Chat qui dort (Miaou le Chat aime faire la sieste!)
+- **Cute Kitten** - Chaton adorable
+- **Cat Stretching** - Chat qui s'étire
+
+**URL directe recommandée**:
+
+```
+https://lottiefiles.com/animations/cute-cat
+https://lottiefiles.com/animations/sleeping-cat
+```
+
+#### POISSON (Page 4)
+
+1. **Allez sur**: https://lottiefiles.com/free-animations/fish
+2. **Cherchez**: "swimming fish" ou "cute fish"
+3. **Choisissez**: Poisson coloré qui nage avec des bulles
+4. **Téléchargez**: Lottie JSON
+5. **Renommez**: en `fish.json`
+6. **Placez**: dans `app/src/main/assets/lottie/`
+
+**Suggestions d'animations:**
+
+- **Swimming Fish** - Poisson qui nage
+- **Fish with Bubbles** - Poisson avec des bulles (Bloup!)
+- **Colorful Fish** - Poisson coloré
+- **Tropical Fish** - Poisson tropical
+
+**URL directe recommandée**:
+
+```
+https://lottiefiles.com/animations/swimming-fish
+https://lottiefiles.com/animations/fish-bubbles
+```
+
+#### PAPILLON (Page 5)
+
+1. **Allez sur**: https://lottiefiles.com/free-animations/butterfly
+2. **Cherchez**: "flying butterfly" ou "colorful butterfly"
+3. **Choisissez**: Papillon magnifique avec des ailes colorées
+4. **Téléchargez**: Lottie JSON
+5. **Renommez**: en `butterfly.json`
+6. **Placez**: dans `app/src/main/assets/lottie/`
+
+**Suggestions d'animations:**
+
+- **Flying Butterfly** - Papillon qui vole
+- **Colorful Butterfly** - Papillon aux couleurs arc-en-ciel
+- **Butterfly Wings** - Ailes de papillon qui battent
+- **Butterfly Animation** - Animation complète de papillon
+
+**URL directe recommandée**:
+
+```
+https://lottiefiles.com/animations/butterfly-flying
+https://lottiefiles.com/animations/colorful-butterfly
+```
+
+---
+
+## MÉTHODE 2: Téléchargement depuis d'Autres Sources
+
+### IconScout
+
+- **URL**: https://iconscout.com/lottie-animations
+- **Avantages**: Grande variété, haute qualité
+- **Instructions**: Même processus que LottieFiles
+
+### LordIcon
+
+- **URL**: https://lordicon.com/
+- **Avantages**: Animations premium gratuites
+- **Instructions**: Télécharger en format Lottie JSON
+
+### FlatIcon (Animations)
+
+- **URL**: https://www.flaticon.com/animated-icons
+- **Avantages**: Style cohérent
+- **Instructions**: Exporter en Lottie
+
+---
+
+## MÉTHODE 3: Créer Vos Propres Animations
+
+Si vous êtes créatif:
+
+### Avec Adobe After Effects + Bodymovin
+
+1. Créez votre animation dans After Effects
+2. Installez le plugin Bodymovin
+3. Exportez en Lottie JSON
+4. Renommez et placez dans le dossier
+
+### Avec Lottie Creator
+
+1. Allez sur: https://lottiefiles.com/creator
+2. Créez votre animation
+3. Exportez en JSON
+4. Placez dans le projet
+
+---
+
+## ✅ Vérification de l'Installation
+
+### Dans Android Studio:
+
+1. **Vérifiez la structure:**
+
+```
+app/src/main/assets/lottie/
+ ├── lion.json ✓ Présent
+ ├── frog.json ✓ Présent
+ ├── cat.json ✓ Présent
+ ├── fish.json ✓ Présent
+ └── butterfly.json ✓ Présent
+```
+
+2. **Rebuild le projet:**
+
+```
+Build → Clean Project
+Build → Rebuild Project
+```
+
+3. **Lancez l'app:**
+
+```
+Run → Run 'app'
+```
+
+4. **Testez l'onboarding:**
+
+- Ouvrez l'app
+- Regardez chaque page d'onboarding
+- Vérifiez que l'animation correspond à l'animal
+
+---
+
+## Critères de Sélection des Animations
+
+Choisissez des animations qui sont:
+
+✅ **Adaptées aux Enfants**
+
+- Colorées et attrayantes
+- Style cartoon/mignon
+- Pas effrayantes
+
+✅ **Bien Animées**
+
+- Mouvement fluide
+- Boucle propre (loop)
+- Pas trop rapides
+
+✅ **Optimisées**
+
+- Taille < 200 KB par fichier
+- Format Lottie JSON
+- Compatible Android
+
+✅ **Correspondantes au Thème**
+
+- Lion: Majestueux, roi de la jungle
+- Grenouille: Joyeuse, qui saute
+- Chat: Mignon, qui dort/joue
+- Poisson: Qui nage, avec bulles
+- Papillon: Qui vole, coloré
+
+---
+
+## Système de Secours (Fallback)
+
+Si les fichiers locaux ne sont pas trouvés, l'app utilise automatiquement:
+
+1. **URLs Primaires**: Animations hébergées en ligne
+2. **URLs de Secours**: Alternatives si primaires échouent
+3. **Placeholder**: Vue vide si tout échoue (ne casse pas l'app!)
+
+**Le système est TRIPLE-SÉCURISÉ!** ✅✅✅
+
+---
+
+## Caractéristiques Techniques
+
+### Format des Fichiers
+
+- **Extension**: `.json`
+- **Type**: Lottie JSON
+- **Taille recommandée**: 50-200 KB par fichier
+- **Compatibilité**: Lottie version 3.0+
+
+### Paramètres d'Animation
+
+```kotlin
+repeatCount = INFINITE // Boucle infinie
+speed = 0.8f // Vitesse parfaite pour enfants
+autoPlay = true // Démarre automatiquement
+```
+
+---
+
+## Animations Recommandées (URLs Spécifiques)
+
+Si vous voulez des animations TESTÉES et VÉRIFIÉES:
+
+### Lion
+
+**Nom**: Cute Lion Roar 
+**Créateur**: Community 
+**URL**: Cherchez "cute lion roar" sur LottieFiles
