689|## Troubleshooting Common Issues
690|
691|### Build Issues
692|
693|**Problem**: ProGuard errors during release build
694|**Solution**: Check proguard-rules.pro and add necessary keep rules
695|
696|**Problem**: Signing configuration not found
697|**Solution**: Verify keystore.properties file exists and paths are correct
698|
699|**Problem**: AAB too large
700|**Solution**:
701|
702|- Run `./gradlew :app:analyzeReleaseBundle`
703|- Remove unused resources
704|- Compress images
705|- Use vector drawables where possible
706|
707|### Runtime Issues
708|
709|**Problem**: App crashes on startup
710|**Solution**: Test release build thoroughly before submission
711|
712|**Problem**: Lottie animations not loading
713|**Solution**: Verify JSON files are in res/raw/ folder
714|
715|**Problem**: Videos not playing
716|**Solution**: Ensure ExoPlayer dependencies are correct

Brief description (Short description — ≤80 chars)
**Alpha-Pals: Learn Arabic & French alphabets with tracing, sounds & fun!**

### Full description (Google Play Console — ≤4000 chars)
**Alpha-Pals** is a fun, child-friendly learning app that helps kids discover **Arabic** and **French** alphabets through interactive play.

**What kids can do**
- **Learn letters in 2 languages**: Arabic letters and French A–Z
- **Trace letters** with guided practice and **instant feedback**
- Get a **congratulations reward** when a letter is traced correctly and continue to the **next letter**
- **Listen to clear pronunciation** and repeat sounds anytime
- Enjoy a colorful onboarding experience with **cute animations**

**Optional video learning**
- Watch curated educational videos (requires internet)
- Core learning features work **offline** (videos are optional)

**Parent-friendly & safe**
- **No ads**
- **No in-app purchases**
- **No account required**
- **No personal data collected**
- Designed for young learners and family use

**Perfect for**
- Preschool and early learners
- Bilingual families (Arabic/French)
- Building letter recognition, phonics basics, and fine-motor skills through tracing

**Privacy**
We take children’s privacy seriously. Alpha-Pals does not collect personal information. - **What it is**: The Play Store “feature graphic” shown at the top of your store listing.
- **Requirements**: **1024 × 500 px**, **PNG/JPG**, **≤ 15 MB**.
- **What to put on it (recommended)**:
 - App name: **Alpha-Pals**
 - Tagline (short): **“Your kid’s learning buddy”** / **“Learn letters through play”**
 - 1–2 visuals: a cute mascot/animal + letters (Arabic + Latin)
 - Avoid too much text (keep it readable on phones)

### Video (YouTube URL)
- **Optional** (but helps conversion).
- Must be **Public or Unlisted**, **no age restriction**, **no ads**.
- Paste a full link like: `https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VIDEO_ID`
- Best content: 30–60 sec screen recording showing onboarding, alphabet grid, tracing, success popup, and (optional) videos screen.

### Phone screenshots (required)
- **Upload 2–8** (PNG/JPG, **≤ 8 MB each**)
- Must be **16:9 or 9:16** aspect ratio
- Each side between **320 px and 3840 px**
- **For promotion eligibility**: upload **at least 4** screenshots with **minimum 1080 × 1080** resolution.
- Suggested set (8):
 1. Onboarding animals
 2. Language selection (Arabic/French)
 3. Arabic alphabet grid
 4. French alphabet grid
 5. Tracing screen (before)
 6. Tracing success (green + congratulations)
 7. Next letter / progress
 8. Video learning screen (optional)

### Tablet screenshots (7-inch / 10-inch)
- Only required **if** you select tablet devices / want a stronger listing there.
- **7-inch**: up to 8 images, **16:9 or 9:16**, each side **320–3840 px**, **≤ 8 MB**
- **10-inch**: up to 8 images, **16:9 or 9:16**, each side **1080–7680 px**, **≤ 8 MB**
- Tip: you can often reuse phone screenshots only if they still look good and meet size/aspect rules.

### Chromebook screenshots / Android XR / XR videos

- Remember the **store password**, **key password**, and **alias**.
- Keep `upload-keystore.jks` safe (back it up). If you lose it, you can’t update the same app.

### 2) Create `keystore.properties` (do NOT commit)
Copy the example we added and fill in your real values:

- Copy `keystore.properties.example` → `keystore.properties`
- Edit `keystore.properties` to match your passwords, e.g.:

```properties
storeFile=keystore/upload-keystore.jks
storePassword=...
keyAlias=upload
keyPassword=...
```

Your project is already set up so **release signing automatically turns on** when `keystore.properties` exists.

### 3) Build your **App Bundle (AAB)** (the thing Play Store needs)
#### Option A (Android Studio)
- **Build → Generate Signed Bundle / APK…**
- Choose **Android App Bundle**
- Module: `app`
- Choose your keystore (`keystore/upload-keystore.jks`), alias, passwords
- Build Type: **release**
- Finish

You’ll get the `.aab` at:
- `app/build/outputs/bundle/release/app-release.aab`

#### Option B (command line)
```bash
.\gradlew :app:bundleRelease
```

### 4) Upload to Google Play Console
- Create app in **Play Console**
- Go to **Release → Testing → Internal testing** (recommended first)
- **Create new release** → upload the `app-release.aab`
- If asked about **Play App Signing**: enable it (Google will manage the app-signing key; your keystore becomes the “upload key”).

### 5) Don’t get blocked (common required checks)
- **Versioning**: every upload must increase `versionCode` in `app/build.gradle.kts`
- **Policies**: complete **App content**, **Data safety**, **Privacy policy URL**, **Target audience (kids app = strict)**, **Ads** declarations, etc.

### 6) Important: your repo is committing build outputs
I updated `.gitignore` to ignore `**/build/`, `*.aab`, `*.apk`, and keystore files so you don’t accidentally commit huge binaries or secrets.

 2|
 3|import android.content.Context
 4|import android.graphics.*
 5|import android.util.AttributeSet
 6|import android.view.MotionEvent
 7|import android.view.View
 8|
 9|/**
 10| * UPGRADED DrawingView - With undo/redo, better drawing, and letter validation!
 11| */
 12|class DrawingView @JvmOverloads constructor(
 13| context: Context,
 14| attrs: AttributeSet? = null,
 15| defStyleAttr: Int = 0
 16|) : View(context, attrs, defStyleAttr) {
 17|
 18| private val drawPath = Path()
 19| private val drawPaint = Paint().apply {
 20| color = Color.parseColor("#FF69B4") // Pink default
 21| isAntiAlias = true
 22| strokeWidth = 20f // Thicker for kids
 23| style = Paint.Style.STROKE
 24| strokeJoin = Paint.Join.ROUND
 25| strokeCap = Paint.Cap.ROUND
 26| }
 27|
 28| private val canvasPaint = Paint(Paint.DITHER_FLAG)
 29| private var canvasBitmap: Bitmap? = null
 30| private var drawCanvas: Canvas? = null
 31|
 32| // Undo/Redo support
 33| private val paths = mutableListOf<Pair<Path, DrawingStyle>>()
 34| private val undoPaths = mutableListOf<Pair<Path, DrawingStyle>>()
 35|
 36| data class DrawingStyle(
 37| val color: Int,
 38| val strokeWidth: Float
 39| )
 40|
 41| // Guide de la lettre
 42| private var guideText: String = ""
 43| private var isLetterCorrect: Boolean = false
 44| private val guidePaint = Paint().apply {
 45| color = Color.LTGRAY
 46| textSize = 600f // MUCH BIGGER for easier tracing!
 47| isAntiAlias = true
 48| textAlign = Paint.Align.CENTER
 49| alpha = 100
 50| typeface = Typeface.create(Typeface.DEFAULT, Typeface.BOLD)
 51| }
 52|
 53| // Callback for when letter is traced correctly
 54| var onLetterTracedCorrectly: (() -> Unit)? = null
 55|
 56| // Validation settings
 57| private var validationEnabled = true
 58| private var hasBeenValidated = false
 59| private val requiredCoveragePercentage = 30f // 30% of letter area needs to be covered
 60| 
 61| init {
 62| setBackgroundColor(Color.WHITE)
 63| }
 64| 
 65| override fun onSizeChanged(w: Int, h: Int, oldw: Int, oldh: Int) {
 66| super.onSizeChanged(w, h, oldw, oldh)
 67| canvasBitmap = Bitmap.createBitmap(w, h, Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888)
 68| drawCanvas = Canvas(canvasBitmap!!)
 69| }
 70| 
 71| override fun onDraw(canvas: Canvas) {
 72| // Dessiner le guide de la lettre - CENTERED PERFECTLY for big letters!
 73| if (guideText.isNotEmpty()) {
 74| // Change color to green if letter is correct! 
 75| if (isLetterCorrect) {
 76| guidePaint.color = Color.parseColor("#4CAF50") // Beautiful green!
 77| guidePaint.alpha = 200 // More visible
 78| } else {
 79| guidePaint.color = Color.LTGRAY
 80| guidePaint.alpha = 100
 81| }
 82|
 83| // Calculate vertical center accounting for text metrics
 84| val textBounds = Rect()
 85| guidePaint.getTextBounds(guideText, 0, guideText.length, textBounds)
 86| val textHeight = textBounds.height()
 87| canvas.drawText(guideText, width / 2f, height / 2f + textHeight / 2f, guidePaint)
 88| }
 89| 
 90| // Dessiner tous les paths précédents
 91| for ((path, drawStyle) in paths) {
 92| val paint = Paint().apply {
 93| color = drawStyle.color
 94| isAntiAlias = true
 95| strokeWidth = drawStyle.strokeWidth
 96| style = Paint.Style.STROKE
 97| strokeJoin = Paint.Join.ROUND
 98| strokeCap = Paint.Cap.ROUND
 99| }
100| canvas.drawPath(path, paint)
101| }
102|
103| // Dessiner le path actuel
104| canvas.drawPath(drawPath, drawPaint)
105| }
106| 
107| override fun onTouchEvent(event: MotionEvent): Boolean {
108| val touchX = event.x
109| val touchY = event.y
110| 
111| when (event.action) {
112| MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN -> {
113| drawPath.moveTo(touchX, touchY)
114| }
115| MotionEvent.ACTION_MOVE -> {
116| drawPath.lineTo(touchX, touchY)
117| }
118| MotionEvent.ACTION_UP -> {
119| // Save current path with its style
120| val pathCopy = Path(drawPath)
121| val styleCopy = DrawingStyle(drawPaint.color, drawPaint.strokeWidth)
122| paths.add(Pair(pathCopy, styleCopy))
123| undoPaths.clear() // Clear redo history
124| drawPath.reset()
125|
126| // Validate letter tracing if enabled and not already validated
127| if (validationEnabled && !hasBeenValidated && guideText.isNotEmpty()) {
128| validateLetterTracing()
129| }
130| }
131|
132| else -> return false
133| }
134|
135| invalidate()
136| return true
137| }
138|
139| /**
140| * Validates if the letter has been traced correctly
141| */
142| private fun validateLetterTracing() {
143| // Need at least 5 strokes to consider validation
144| if (paths.size < 3) return
145|
146| // Calculate coverage percentage
147| val coveragePercentage = calculateLetterCoverage()
148|
149| // Check if coverage meets requirement
150| if (coveragePercentage >= requiredCoveragePercentage) {
151| // Letter traced correctly! 
152| isLetterCorrect = true
153| hasBeenValidated = true
154| invalidate()
155|
156| // Notify success after a short delay for visual feedback
157| postDelayed({
158| onLetterTracedCorrectly?.invoke()
159| }, 500) // 0.5 second delay to show green color
160| }
161| }
162|
163| /**
164| * Calculates what percentage of the letter area is covered by drawing
165| * Simple heuristic: checks if drawing has good distribution across letter area
166| */
167| private fun calculateLetterCoverage(): Float {
168| if (paths.isEmpty() || guideText.isEmpty()) return 0f
169|
170| // Get letter bounds
171| val textBounds = Rect()
172| guidePaint.getTextBounds(guideText, 0, guideText.length, textBounds)
173| val letterCenterX = width / 2f
174| val letterCenterY = height / 2f
175| val letterWidth = textBounds.width()
176| val letterHeight = textBounds.height()
177|
178| // Calculate how many strokes are near the letter area
179| var strokesNearLetter = 0
180| val totalPoints = paths.size
181|
182| for ((path, _) in paths) {
183| val pathMeasure = PathMeasure(path, false)
184| val midPoint = FloatArray(2)
185|
186| // Sample middle point of the stroke
187| if (pathMeasure.length > 0) {
188| pathMeasure.getPosTan(pathMeasure.length / 2, midPoint, null)
189|
190| // Check if point is within letter area (with some margin)
191| val dx = kotlin.math.abs(midPoint[0] - letterCenterX)
192| val dy = kotlin.math.abs(midPoint[1] - letterCenterY)
193| val marginFactor = 1.2f // Allow 20% margin
194|
195| if (dx < letterWidth * marginFactor / 2 && dy < letterHeight * marginFactor / 2) {
196| strokesNearLetter++
197| }
198| }
199| }
200|
201| // Calculate coverage percentage
202| return if (totalPoints > 0) {
203| (strokesNearLetter.toFloat() / totalPoints) * 100f
204| } else {
205| 0f
206| }
207| }
208| 
209| /**
210| * Efface tout le dessin
211| */
212| fun clearDrawing() {
213| drawPath.reset()
214| paths.clear()
215| undoPaths.clear()
216| canvasBitmap?.eraseColor(Color.TRANSPARENT)
217| isLetterCorrect = false
218| hasBeenValidated = false
219| invalidate()
220| }
221|
222| /**
223| * Annule le dernier trait (Undo)
224| */
225| fun undo() {
226| if (paths.isNotEmpty()) {
227| val lastPath = paths.removeAt(paths.size - 1)
228| undoPaths.add(lastPath)
229| invalidate()
230| }
231| }
232|
233| /**
234| * Refait le dernier trait annulé (Redo)
235| */
236| fun redo() {
237| if (undoPaths.isNotEmpty()) {
238| val lastUndoPath = undoPaths.removeAt(undoPaths.size - 1)
239| paths.add(lastUndoPath)
240| invalidate()
241| }
242| }
243|
244| /**
245| * Vérifie si undo est possible
246| */
247| fun canUndo(): Boolean = paths.isNotEmpty()
248|
249| /**
250| * Vérifie si redo est possible
251| */
252| fun canRedo(): Boolean = undoPaths.isNotEmpty()
253|
254| /**
255| * Définit la lettre guide
256| */
257| fun setGuideLetter(letter: String) {
258| guideText = letter
259| isLetterCorrect = false
260| hasBeenValidated = false
261| clearDrawing() // Clear previous drawing when new letter is set
262| invalidate()
263| }
264|
265| /**
266| * Définit la couleur du trait
267| */
268| fun setDrawColor(color: Int) {
269| drawPaint.color = color
270| }
271|
272| /**
273| * Définit l'épaisseur du trait
274| */
275| fun setStrokeWidth(width: Float) {
276| drawPaint.strokeWidth = width
277| }
278|
279| /**
280| * Obtient la couleur actuelle
281| */
282| fun getCurrentColor(): Int = drawPaint.color
283|
284| /**
285| * Obtient l'épaisseur actuelle
286| */
287| fun getCurrentStrokeWidth(): Float = drawPaint.strokeWidth
288|}

 16|/**
 17| * Adapter for displaying educational videos in a RecyclerView
 18| */
 19|class VideoAdapter(
 20| private var videos: List<LearningVideo>,
 21| private val isArabic: Boolean,
 22| private val onVideoClick: (LearningVideo) -> Unit
 23|) : RecyclerView.Adapter<VideoAdapter.VideoViewHolder>() {
 24|
 25| override fun onCreateViewHolder(parent: ViewGroup, viewType: Int): VideoViewHolder {
 26| val binding = ItemVideoBinding.inflate(
 27| LayoutInflater.from(parent.context),
 28| parent,
 29| false
 30| )
 31| return VideoViewHolder(binding)
 32| }
 33|
 34| override fun onBindViewHolder(holder: VideoViewHolder, position: Int) {
 35| holder.bind(videos[position])
 36| }
 37|
 38| override fun getItemCount(): Int = videos.size
 39|
 40| fun updateVideos(newVideos: List<LearningVideo>) {
 41| videos = newVideos
 42| notifyDataSetChanged()
 43| }

 45| inner class VideoViewHolder(
 46| private val binding: ItemVideoBinding
 47| ) : RecyclerView.ViewHolder(binding.root) {
 48|
 49| fun bind(video: LearningVideo) {
 50| val context = binding.root.context
 51|
 52| // Set title based on language
 53| binding.tvVideoTitle.text = if (isArabic) video.titleAr else video.title
 54|
 55| // Set description based on language
 56| binding.tvVideoDescription.text =
 57| if (isArabic) video.descriptionAr else video.description
 58|
 59| // Set duration
 60| if (video.duration.isBlank()) {
 61| binding.tvDuration.visibility = View.GONE
 62| } else {
 63| binding.tvDuration.visibility = View.VISIBLE
 64| binding.tvDuration.text = video.duration
 65| }
 66|
 67| // Load real thumbnail (YouTube)
 68| if (video.thumbnailUrl.isBlank()) {
 69| binding.ivThumbnail.setImageDrawable(null)
 70| } else {
 71| binding.ivThumbnail.load(video.thumbnailUrl) {
 72| crossfade(true)
 73| placeholder(R.drawable.bg_gradient_rainbow)
 74| error(R.drawable.bg_gradient_rainbow)
 75| }
 76| }
 77|
 78| // Language chip (FR/AR)
 79| binding.tvLang.text = when (video.language) {
 80| VideoLanguage.FRENCH -> "FR"
 81| VideoLanguage.ARABIC -> "AR"
 82| VideoLanguage.BOTH -> "FR+AR"
 83| }
 84|
 85| // Set category badge
 86| val categoryText = when (video.category) {
 87| VideoCategory.ALPHABET_SONG -> if (isArabic) "أغنية" else "Chanson"
 88| VideoCategory.HOW_TO_WRITE -> if (isArabic) "كتابة" else "Écriture"
 89| VideoCategory.LETTER_SOUNDS -> if (isArabic) "أصوات" else "Sons"
 90| VideoCategory.FULL_TUTORIAL -> if (isArabic) "درس كامل" else "Tutoriel"
 91| VideoCategory.FUN_LEARNING -> if (isArabic) "تعلم ممتع" else "Amusant"
 92| }
 93| binding.tvCategory.text = categoryText
 94|
 95| // Set category color
 96| val categoryColor = when (video.category) {
 97| VideoCategory.ALPHABET_SONG -> R.color.accent_yellow
 98| VideoCategory.HOW_TO_WRITE -> R.color.accent_pink
 99| VideoCategory.LETTER_SOUNDS -> R.color.accent_cyan
100| VideoCategory.FULL_TUTORIAL -> R.color.accent_orange
101| VideoCategory.FUN_LEARNING -> R.color.accent_purple
102| }
103| val catColorInt = ContextCompat.getColor(context, categoryColor)
104| binding.tvCategory.backgroundTintList = ColorStateList.valueOf(catColorInt)
105| binding.tvCategory.setTextColor(ContextCompat.getColor(context, R.color.white))
106| // Match card stroke to category for a colorful, unique look
107| binding.cardVideo.strokeColor = catColorInt
108|
109| // Click listener
110| binding.cardVideo.setOnClickListener {
111| onVideoClick(video)
112| }
113|
114| // Add animation on bind
115| binding.cardVideo.alpha = 0f

119| .alpha(1f)

121| .scaleY(1f)
122| .setDuration(300)

124| .start()

 18|/**

 21|class VideoPlayerActivity : BaseActivity() {
 22|
 23| private lateinit var binding: ActivityVideoPlayerBinding
 24| private var player: ExoPlayer? = null
 25| private var videoUrl: String = ""
 26| private var videoTitle: String = ""
 27| private var isFullscreen = false
 28|
 29| override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
 30| super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
 31|
 32| // Keep screen on during video playback
 33| window.addFlags(WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_KEEP_SCREEN_ON)
 34|
 35| binding = ActivityVideoPlayerBinding.inflate(layoutInflater)
 36| setContentView(binding.root)
 37|
 38| // Get video data from intent
 39| videoUrl = intent.getStringExtra("VIDEO_URL") ?: ""
 40| videoTitle = intent.getStringExtra("VIDEO_TITLE") ?: ""
 41|
 42| if (videoUrl.isEmpty()) {
 43| showError(getString(R.string.video_error))
 44| return
 45| }
 46|
 47| setupPlayer()
 48| setupUI()
 49| }
 50|
 51| private fun setupPlayer() {
 52| // Initialize ExoPlayer
 53| player = ExoPlayer.Builder(this).build().also { exoPlayer ->
 54| binding.playerView.player = exoPlayer
 55|
 56| // ExoPlayer can't play regular YouTube page URLs. Open those externally.
 57| if (videoUrl.contains("youtube.com") || videoUrl.contains("youtu.be")) {
 58| try {
 59| startActivity(Intent(Intent.ACTION_VIEW, Uri.parse(videoUrl)))
 60| } catch (e: Exception) {
 61| showError(getString(R.string.video_error))
 62| }
 63| finish()
 64| return
 65| }
 66|
 67| // Prepare media for direct stream/local URIs (mp4, m3u8, etc.)
 68| val mediaItem = MediaItem.fromUri(videoUrl)
 69|
 70| exoPlayer.setMediaItem(mediaItem)
 71| exoPlayer.prepare()
 72|
 73| // Add player listener
 74| exoPlayer.addListener(object : Player.Listener {
 75| override fun onPlaybackStateChanged(playbackState: Int) {
 76| when (playbackState) {
 77| Player.STATE_BUFFERING -> {
